articleTitle: An Optimised Design of a 4-bit Carry Look-Ahead Adder Using Novel Reversible Logic Gates
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Reversible logic gates are pivotal in the advancement of low-power and quantum computing technologies due to their ability to operate without generating heat from information loss. This field of study has emerged as a forefront of research, propelling innovative advancements aimed at optimizing resource efficiency. This paper presents the design and implementation of a 4-bit Carry Look-Ahead (CLA) adder using reversible logic gates, significantly enhancing arithmetic operation speed by computing carry bits in parallel. The CLA adder uses generate (G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>) and propagate (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>) functions to determine carry bits, reducing the delay associated with traditional adders. The proposed design leverages a combination of Peres and Feynman gates to construct the Carry Propagate and Carry Generate Adder (PGA) block, producing the necessary carry and sum outputs efficiently. There is an approximate 41% improvement in the total reversible implementation cost (TRLIC) of the design. Evaluated using Vivado 2022.2 with Verilog HDL, the design demonstrates accurate and efficient performance across all 4-bit input combinations, significantly reducing propagation delay.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in IoT Data Streams Based on Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Nowadays, the swift growth of Ambient Intelligence (AmI) in Internet of Things (IoT), sensing devices have been generating many data streams in intelligent scenarios. The IoT deployment issues, complexity of systems is leading to abnormal behavior in data streams. Moreover, the dynamic and consecutive data streams generated in IoT systems leads to difficulty in determining anomaly detection. Therefore, this paper presents a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Sparse Autoencoder method for classification of data to determine anomaly behavior in IoT data streams. Firstly, a min-max normalization technique is employed to scale the input data for better results and Sparse Autoencoder utilizes sparsity penalty to capture relevant features. The LSTM network is employed for prediction tasks which leverages the ability to handle sequential IoT data streams and dropout layers are utilized to prevent overfitting. Finally, K-means clustering mechanism is used to establish an error threshold for anomaly detection. The performance of proposed LSTM and Sparse Autoencoder is evaluated on SKAB dataset which illustrated higher precision (0.824), recall (0.982) and f1 scores (0.847). The proposed method outperformed existing anomaly detection methods such as Neural Network (NN), Adaptable and Interpretable Framework for Anomaly Detection (AID).

articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation Service in University Libraries using Hybrid Collaborative Filtering Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: University libraries provide a disciplinary function in addressing the educational demands of students, researchers, and faculty. However, it overloads the system with data, making it difficult for users to access relevant resources. Traditional Collaborative Filtering Recommendation (CFR) System often suffer with the data sparsity and cold-start problem which leads to low user level satisfaction. To address these issues, a hybrid CFR is proposed in this research, to improve the recommendation services in university libraries. The hybrid recommendation system combines content-based filtering and user-based collaborative filtering and the clustering algorithm. To reduce the sparsity, precise K-means clustering is used to cluster the similar users together to get the better result for the recommendations. Also, the adaption of content-based methods reduces the cold-start issue and provides a way of ensuring that new users and items are recommended the right study resources. The proposed hybrid CFR system is consequently applied for a personalized recommendation services in university library and show better recommended accuracy with 99.74%, recommended recall rate of 0.73, and Mean Square Error (MSE) of 0.49 when compared to existing CFR methods optimized hybrid CFR and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) based CFR.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition and Translation Using Self-Attention Long-Short-Term Memory with Shape Autotuning Activation Function
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: An efficient Indian Sign Language recognition (ISL) identifies the sign language gestures to ease communication among the non-signer and signer community. It is a graphic form of communication where the community of hearing-impaired exists and this sign language raises independently from local spoken language. However, sign language recognition and translation face constraints due to variability in sign production between individuals and contextual ambiguity which makes it difficulties for models to generalize and accurately interpret signs in various contexts. This research proposes Self-Attention Long-Short-Term Memory with Shape Autotuning Activation Function (SALSTM-SAAF) to recognize and translate sign language. RA allows the model to focus on essential parts and LSTM captures temporal dependencies which ensures effective sequence learning. SAAF adjusts to different input shapes which optimizes the learning process and enhances the model’s performance. Data augmentation and min-max normalization are applied to increase the dataset size and normalize the obtained data. Then, the ResNet is used to extract the features from pre-processed data effectively. The SALSTM-SAAF achieves a better accuracy of 99.87% compared to existing methods like VGG19-Bidirectional LSTM (VGG19-BiLSTM).

articleTitle: Fault Detection in Smart Grids by Hybrid Generative Adversarial Networks with Neuro Fuzzy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Inrecent years, integration of advanced communication networks and estimation techniques smart grid enables real time analysis and has control to optimize distribution of energy, improve grid resilience. Detecting and classification of faults in electricity networks is important for uninterrupted provision and maintenance of costs at minimum. By implementing data-driven approaches these systems brought many improvements like consumption of energy and quick re-establishment. In this paper, hybrid Generative adversarial networks (GAN) – neuro fuzzy algorithm is implemented for detection of faults in smart grids and done by extraction of features which are extracted from smart meters, training is done by GAN then trained model is further sent for classification which is done by neuro fuzzy algorithm if there is a fault then model sent for identification or location of fault and evaluation of accuracy is done, if there is no fault then again sent to feature extraction process. Proposed hybrid GAN-neuro fuzzy algorithm achieved 95.33 % of precision and 97.23 % of recall.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Approach Recommendation System in Internet of Medical Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Healthcare is rapidly advancing in the field of the Internet of Things (IoT). In the realm of the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT), a plethora of medical data is generated from various devices such as wearables, sensors, and medical imaging tools. An intelligent recommendation system for healthcare professionals becomes imperative in this context. These devices generate massive amounts of patient health data, allowing for personalized healthcare solutions. The proposed work investigates the use of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning approaches to build smart recommendation systems for healthcare users. This enables to offer personalized and timely suggestions for treatments and preventive measures, thereby enhancing patient care and improving healthcare services and decision-making. Finally, the proposed scheme is implemented to evaluate the performance of system in terms of accuracy, training time, and recommendations.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Intrusion Detection System using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) plays an essential character in both domestic and corporate sectors by facilitating connectivity and automation through a network of devices and sensors. IoT wearable gadgets, sensors, and embedded devices are widely utilized for data collection and transmission. However, privacy and security are challenging tasks to be achieved while the standard implementation of monitoring and security operations is not possible because of large number of IoT devices, their heterogeneity and technical specification limitations. In order to solve this issue, Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is introduced to secure the network against various vulnerabilities and threats. To identify intrusion attacks accurately, Machine learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) algorithms namely, Random Forest (RF), Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DL), AdaBoost, XGboost, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Deep Neural Network (DNN) are used. This research aims to identify the strengths, relationship, and challenges of the ML and DL-based prediction approaches.

articleTitle: A Comparator Tree Design with Optimized Quantum Cost Using Reversible Logic Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Reversible logic is gaining increasing significance in diverse research areas, including quantum computing, nanotechnology, and optical computing. The exploration of reversible gates has emerged as a cutting-edge research area, driving a wave of innovative developments aimed at maximizing resource efficiency. This work focused on creating highly efficient 2-bit, 8-bit, and 64-bit comparators, leveraging the advantages of reversible logic gates. The results obtained from the comparative analysis demonstrate substantial improvements in energy efficiency and computational speed compared to other architectures. The proposed design demonstrated superior performance with reduced quantum cost and delay while minimizing garbage outputs. Specifically, the quantum costs of the 2-bit, 8-bit, and 64-bit comparators were measured to be 20, 128, and 1136, respectively. These outcomes suggest substantial enhancements in a variety of parameters, which ultimately will result in a more efficient and effective design. The functionality of the designed comparator tree was validated using Xilinx Vivado 2022.2 and implemented in Verilog HDL.

articleTitle: Design and Application of an International Trade Trading Platform Based on ElGamal and Elliptic Curve Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Network security has attracted numerous people and significantly develop a subject in international trade actions. Conventional trade procedure suffers from the large number of problems about the mediators, data latency and privacy. The development of blockchain technology have become potential to solve the problems through transforming the business procedure over the enterprise borders in different industries. To overcome this issue, this research proposes the hybrid cryptographic algorithm of ElGamal and Elliptic Curve Cryptography (EECC) approach for the analysis of international trade trading system. ECC provides effective security by smaller key sizes, designing it complex for attackers to break the encryption through brute-force attacks. ElGamal extends an additional layer of security through allowing an encryption according to Diffie-Hellman key exchange, further securing data. This research significantly studied the blockchain in international trade application, developed its privacy and effective distributed network and verified its effectiveness. The results shows that the proposed method attains better throughput of 210p/s on a centralized authorization manager.

articleTitle: An Efficient BCD Adder Design Utilizing Reversible Logic Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Reversible logic gates are pivotal components in digital circuit design, embodying the principle of reversibility that ensures each input state maps uniquely to a distinct output state without loss of information. Leveraging these principles, this paper presents a novel design and validation of a Binary-Coded Decimal (BCD) adder utilizing reversible logic gates, specifically ASK gates and New Gate (NG). Through the seamless integration of ASK and NG gates, the proposed design achieves significant improvements in efficiency and performance metrics. The design and validation processes are carried out using Xilinx Vivado 2022.2 software. Notably, it demonstrates a substantial reduction in gate count and ancilla inputs while effectively managing garbage outputs. The design features a gate count of 11, employs 13 ancilla inputs, and generates 22 garbage outputs, showcasing a remarkable 63.33% reduction in gate count compared to existing architectures. These findings highlight the efficiency, scalability, and potential applications of the proposed design in various domains including quantum computing, low-power systems, error-correction mechanisms, cryptography.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Highway Engineering Test using Mixed Finite Element Modelling Based Detection Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The Detection Management System (DMS) in Highway Engineering Test (HET) plays a crucial role in ensuring the structural integrity of the road networks. These systems are useful in evaluating the state of the highways and bridges and any other structures mainly indicating the older infrastructures and the increasing traffic density. The current research used Mixed Finite Element Modelling (MFEM) based DMS for the HET aimed at increasing the safety, efficiency and durability of the highway structures. The methodology involves determining the structural identification through load testing and Non Destructive Evaluation (NDE) that involves Vibration Analysis Test and Ground Penetrating Radar. This updates the model structural responses that in turn enable identification and prediction of the potential failure modes. The experimental results show the approach enhanced the decision-making process of highway engineering projects to improve performance and safety of important transportation structures by obtained results in terms of monitoring accuracy 98.88%, and precision in detecting risks at 97.65% at Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) of 30dB when compared to the existing methods such as Non-Contact Testing (NCT) and Distributed Fibre Optic Sensors (DFOS).

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Embedded Customer Relationship Management for Business-to-Business Firms using Improved Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The influence of adopting an Artificial Intelligence-embedded Customer Relationship Management (AI-CRM) system for Business-to-Business (B2B) firm’s Relationship Management (RM) is crucial. However, in the existing models, there are some limitations such as inadequate data and error in prediction which affects decision making of firm, causing defects in RM. To overcome this, an Improved Long Short-Term Memory in automatic decision-making model that reduces error and enhances prediction, positively impacting the relationship of firms is proposed. Initially, a questionnaire-based data is acquired from14 firms in B2B context with 312 responses. The proposed decision making model in AI-embedded CRM system has a substantial positive impact on relationship satisfaction and hence the firm’s performance and B2B. Also, the negative impact of technology turbulence moderator on the relationships of ADM is highlighted with the satisfaction result of Operational Efficiency (OE) with B2B relationship, as mentioned in this research. The positive impact of leadership support moderator on the firm’s performance and B2B relationship satisfaction is also increased by decision making in the proposed conceptual model. In future, advanced deep neural network will be implemented to enhance CRM with AI integration in B2B firms.

Author Keywords: firms relationship and improved long short-term memory

articleTitle: Levy Flight Osprey Optimization Algorithm for Task Scheduling in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Task scheduling in a Cloud Computing (CC) environment offers flexible and scalable computing resources that encounter critical challenges that significantly affect the system performance. The existing methods often suffer from minimal convergence rates due to ineffective task scheduling, leading to a degradation in the quality of task scheduling in the CC environment. This paper proposes the Levy Flight Osprey Optimization Algorithm (LFOOA) for task scheduling, which provides high-quality scheduling solutions due to its effective search mechanisms. The novel approach aims to improve the convergence rate and reduce the time required for evaluation. The significance of task scheduling in CC lies in its responsibility for assigning tasks to each virtual machine, optimising execution time, and minimizing energy consumption. The existing methods namely, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Random Double Adaptive Whale Optimization Algorithm (RDWOA) and Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) and PS-Grey Wolf Optimization (PSGWO) are evaluated in the proposed method. The LDOOA approach achieves better performance with a makespan of 97, resource utilization of 99%, and energy consumption of 1.1.

Author Keywords: Task Scheduling and Whale Optimization Algorithm

articleTitle: A Secure Storage System for Financial Data based on Fuzzy Recognition Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This electronic document is a "live" template and already defines the coThe purpose of this paper is to develop a secure storage system for financial data based on fuzzy recognition algorithm to improve the security, accuracy and reliability of financial data and its applications. The system adopts the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm to carry out intelligent analysis and processing of financial data. This paper begins to carry out specific research on the part of algorithm selection and algorithm implementation, and elaborates on the whole process, so as to explain the algorithm clearly and provide support for its subsequent application. The system test results show that the data encryption method and strict access control mechanism are used to ensure the security of data and the system has excellent performance in terms of data storage performance, encryption and decryption speed, API response time and system availability, throughput and error rate, etc., which can effectively meet the needs of safe, reliable and efficient financial data storage and management.

articleTitle: Power Quality Evaluation and Improvement in Electric Arc Furnace using UPQC
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Electric arc furnaces (EAFs) have become more popular for producing steel due to the rising demand for high-quality steel, the chaotic nature of EAF process contributes significantly for the degradation of power quality due to injection of harmonics and voltage fluctuations emphasizing the need of compensators to suppress the PQ distortions. This paper attempts to develop and simulate the mathematical model of an EAF using Cassie-Mayr method for evaluation of harmonic and voltage fluctuations and proposes the shunt active series filter, series active power filter and Unified power quality conditioner for suppression of current harmonic, voltage harmonics and overall PQ distortions. The simulations are carried out using Simulink, the results obtained justifies the performance of proposed UPQC resulting in reduction of voltage and current harmonics from 20.5 and 54% to 2.39% and 2.4% respectively.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model for Network Information Dissemination based on Optimized Convolutional Neural Network Using Enhanced Kepler Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The information dissemination methodology effectively measures the spread of opinions in Social Networks (SNs). Because of the unpredictability, irregularity of data, complexity, typical data distribution index systems rely heavily on human intervention, have substantial deviations, and are used in a narrow range. In prior researches, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based strategy is created from critical viewpoints for creating a multilayer and multigranular information dissemination index system. However, as information grows, the CNN requires the best parameter specifications, as well as a more specialized system for particular information dissemination events on various themes. Thus, an Enhanced Kepler Optimization Algorithm (EKOA) approach is developed to tune the hyperparameters of the CNN for the prediction of network information dissemination. Then the weight is trained, and it is used to determine the weight of information dissemination methods. The simulation findings show that EKOA-CNN achieves 99.98% and outperforms other approaches such as game inference cellular automaton model (SEInR), and CNN.

articleTitle: Municipal Engineering Construction Management using Elite Individual Reserving strategy-based Fire Fly Optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In municipal engineering construction management, to enhance on-site layout progress, a Multi-Objective (MO) optimization model is used to estimate the rationality of Site Layout (SL) based on the most important indicators of safety, time and cost. However, the existing models struggle to adapt to these dynamic changes in real-time, potentially leading to suboptimal layouts or the need for frequent recalculations. To overcome these drawbacks, an Elite Individual Reserving Strategy based Fire Fly Optimization (EIR-FFO) algorithm for analyzing rationality of on-site layout to enhance construction project process, minimizing cost and increasing safety. This EIR-FFO optimization algorithm handle multiple objectives simultaneously, that provide a balanced set of solutions to consider all factors such as cost, safety and time. Initially, the data about the site are acquired and a site-layout is designed to evaluate rationality. After that, various dimensionality of transportation time and cost factors are standardized by min-max standardization method and evaluation of factors of on-site layout are evaluated precisely. The experimental results of proposed method algorithm achieved accuracy of 97% for cost which is higher than existing methods such as Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA).

Author Keywords: elite individual reserving strategy based fire fly

articleTitle: Multi Resolution based Graph Convolutional Networks for Detecting Communities in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Detecting the fundamental community structure of a social network is crucial in social network analysis. All though, there are many recent approaches in detecting communities, analysing large scale social networks at all resolutions is a challenging task. To solve this problem, the proposed research focuses on developing an efficient Multi Resolution-Graph Convolutional Network (MR-GCN) to identify the communities in social networks. The proposed method with the graph mining technique improves the output graph quality in identifying the communities. The conventional approaches depend on the labelled data, which is limited data in the real time applications. Initially, the nodes of raw graph are converted into embeddings and are further processed by multiple layers of a GCN to incorporate both the local and global structural features. The MR feature fusion is used to combine node embeddings from different resolutions, which includes all necessary information. The final phase includes Adam optimizer to train the model, and the overall experimental results obtained are accuracy of 97.85%, precision of 96.57%, and f1-score of 95.77%. The proposed method results are compared with the existing methods such as Graph Neural Network encoding scheme for a Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm (GNN-MOEA) and Markov Random Fields GCN (MRFasGCN).

articleTitle: Application of Improved Genetic Algorithm in Intelligent Network Technology for Enterprise Financial Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of corporate financial services, network security issues have become increasingly complex, posing a serious threat to corporate development and the security of financial services. In view of the challenges of corporate financial network security, this article studies the application of Improved Genetic Algorithm (IGA) in improving corporate financial security intelligent network technology. Research methods include analyzing the shortcomings of traditional genetic algorithms, applying improvement strategies, and verifying the effectiveness of improved genetic algorithms through experiments. Research results show that the improved genetic algorithm achieved a high accuracy of 97.4% in prediction accuracy, significantly improving the stability and reliability of enterprise financial security intelligent network technology. The conclusion points out that although the improved genetic algorithm has achieved positive results in improving corporate financial network security, further optimization is still needed to improve the efficiency of the algorithm. Future research will explore parameter tuning of IGA or integration strategies with other algorithms to achieve more efficient network security protection.

articleTitle: Authentication and Access Control in Software Defined Network-Internet of Things: A Security Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The study’s primary goal is to prevent unauthorized people and systems from accessing protected resources in a way that goes beyond their permissions. It aims to provide an overview of authentication and access control methods while showcasing current research developments in the SDN-IoT space. The review discusses current Authentication and Access Control approaches and technologies, including security difficulties, risks, and numerous technological innovations. Finally, it also covers the various authentication and access control existing mechanisms and how technology might be incorporated into a network’s architecture plan.

articleTitle: Random Forest based Coral Reef Health Classification Using Satellite Imagery and Geographical Information System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Understanding the coral reefs’ health in varied climate changes is challenging with the traditional methods. To address this, the proposed research developed a Machine Learning (ML) framework for effective classification using Geographical Information System (GIS). The data in this research, is collected from Great Barrier Reef (GBR) in Australia which includes the satellite Landsat 8 images for monitoring coral reefs condition. The data is pre-processed using normalization and scatter plots to analyse various coral reef classes using the training samples. The images features are extracted using Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and analysed the spectral indices to capture specific type of information about the coral reefs. The coral reef images are then segmented using Pixel Based (PB) and Object Based (OB) segmentation to achieve effective Coral Reef Health Classification (CRHC). To analyse the large amount of data with the non-linear relationships between the variables, the Random Forest (RF) classifier is used. The experimental results showed that the proposed RF-CRHC achieved better accuracy with 99.59% and precision with 97.79% when compared to the existing methods Multi-Local Perception Network (ML-Net) and Clustering based RF.

articleTitle: A Chaotic Gradient-based Optimization with Support Vector Machine for Chinese Folk Music Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Nowadays, Chinese folk music classification has a huge attraction on the researches end where traditional Chinese folk music classification has difficulty with feature selection, and current Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have limitations such as poor classification accuracy. Conventional music classification algorithms struggle to accurately classify Chinese folk music due to its sensitive rhythms and tone changes. The goal is to develop algorithms that can accurately recognize and classify diverse folk tunes in the Chinese music collection. So, Chaotic Gradient-Based Optimizer (CGBO) is introduced that merges chaotic maps with GBO searching rounds to find the most discriminating features and finally for folk music categorization, the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm is used. In this research to evaluate the performance of the proposed CGBO-SVM, input data is created by self as set of ethnic music data, this data collection includes 10 different genres. Every genre includes minimum count of 100 samples, and every sample lasting 30 secs with sampling rate of 22050 Hz, while the One Note detector technique is utilized to effectively extract features. The experimental results reveal that the suggested CGBO-SVM achieve 99.96% of classification accuracy and performs better than existing approaches such as K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Bi-Directional Long Short Term Memory (Bi-LSTM).

articleTitle: Block-chain based University Innovation and Entrepreneurship Information Sharing Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With help of entrepreneurship and innovation platforms, the university students have acquired useful data in appropriate time and efficient manner, adapts to modifies in external environment and makes appropriate entrepreneurial roles in time manner. For enhancing the effectiveness of universities innovation and education of entrepreneurship data sharing platform depended on block chain technique. And the platform for testing, in experiments, the information acquisition of time period 100 to 500 seconds and training set size, length of distribution of big data and width of intelligent symbol of scheduling. The performance results represent that block-chain technique depended on user feature information minimizes user evaluation matrix for certain extends. The rapid growing of user information, information ability in innovation and business information sharing platform are maximizing. By testing, it is identified that the present chosen technique and their optimization process are efficient, that enhanced based on classical techniques for supporting recommendation system for producing the good outcomes. The block-chain technique played the significant role in university student’s entrepreneurship and innovation and promoted the university innovation and entrepreneurship of students.

articleTitle: Image Text Translation Technology based on Time Convolutional Network Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Text translation is a process Machine translation from image to text by computer programs to translate natural source language into a precise other language. However, translation text from image has drawback of ineffective deep learning models which translate the words inaccurate due to missing important keyword extraction from the image. To overcome these limitations, a Time Convolutional Network based Transformer (TCN-Transformer) is proposed to make the text translation process more effective in image to text translation technology. The integration of TCN with transformer is highly adaptive, and analyze the patterns in a student's language use to adapt lessons to their specific learning. By effectively capturing both temporal patterns and contextual meaning, the system can deliver more precise and personalized feedback on pronunciation, grammar, and usage. Initially, the text with image dataset ae acquired and preprocessed by binarization technique and segmented by broken character approach for overlapping characters to improve text translation. Then, significant features from the segmented characters are finally classified and translated by the proposed TCN-Transformer method. The experimental results of the proposed method achieved accuracy of 84.82% which is better than existing method such as Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM).

articleTitle: Design of English Teaching Assisted System using Tokenizer Attention Mechanism based Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: English assisted system has gained greater popularity and a part of national English education due to the demands of international economy as well as international politics. The important task in assisted system to improve educational quality and speed up educational modernization that increases and development for educational informatization. However, the teaching model in English assisted system has limitation of extracting limited keywords from specific texts which reduced the effectiveness of teaching system. To overcome this, a Tokenizer Attention Mechanism based Long Short-Term Memory (TAM-LSTM) is employed to enhance English assisted teaching system. Initially, system translation using corpus and rule based methods are described and utilized an improved chart parsing algorithm for translation of English texts. Then, translation memory format with basic entry and format entry is designed for storing the translated data. Finally, the proposed TAM-LSTM model in assisted teaching system enhanced teaching process of English by extracting important keywords effectively. The experimental results of proposed method achieved 85.82% accuracy when compared to existing method LSTM.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Skin Lesion Classification using Pre-Trained Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of skin cancer underscores the importance of accurate and efficient diagnostic tools. Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNN) have demonstrated remarkable success in computer vision tasks, particularly in skin cancer classification. However, adapting these networks to specific domains, such as dermatoscopic images, poses challenges. This project addresses the need for robust skin cancer classification by fine-tuning DCNNs pre-trained on ImageNet for the specific task of identifying 7 types of skin lesions using the HAM10000 dataset, which contains 10,000 dermatoscopic images. To comprehensively assess the efficiency of different fine-tuning strategies, a comparative analysis is conducted across multiple architectures, including the baseline model, VGG16, Inception V3, InceptionResNetV2, and DenseNet201. The initial examination involves fine-tuning the top layers of each architecture. Subsequently, a more intricate analysis is performed by fine-tuning all layers for Inception V3, InceptionResNetV2, and DenseNet201. This study aimed to improve dermatological image classification by combining cross-learning and ensemble learning. The ensemble included the best versions of Inception V3 and DenseNet 201, achieving an accuracy of 88.52% on the test set and 88.8% on the validation set. The fitting of the whole model improved the results and the speed of convergence.

articleTitle: Predicting Novels Popularity Based on Optimized Random Forest using Success History Intelligent Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Reading novels help people to develop their social skills and mainly helps to reduce stress. In that, predicting novel popularity becomes a difficult task that is impacted by amount of variables, including reader preferences, sales patterns, and literary qualities. Machine Learning (ML) techniques are highly recommended for prediction task wherein using the Random Forest (RF), the popularity of sentiment as well as emotional variables derived from the narrative text of novels has been predicted. Since these techniques are heavily relied on hyperparameter values because, when optimized hyperparameters have been defined and modified during the training process, their predicted accuracy could improve. In order to fine-tune the RF hyperparameters, a Success History Intelligent Optimisation (SHIO) is presented for the prediction of popularity of online novels. A total of 2,439 eBooks/novels around nine distinct categories in the online publishing from Project Gutenberg. By addressing the issue of consumer information overload, these vectors could become beneficial for advancing the development of novel recommender systems. The SHIO-RF achieves a lower Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.15 and outperforms the compared conventional algorithms including Shapley Additive explanations and Light Gradient Boosting Machine Classifier (SHAP-LGBM), Attention Mechanism based Graph Neural Network (AM-GNN) and RF.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Aerospace Accelerometer Testing System using Gap Statistics Based K-Means Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In an aerospace industry, pyroshock testing is a crucial phase in developing the space electronics. With respect to fulfill a vibration exposure requires in maximum temperature surroundings like aerospace, maximum temperature manufacture as well as nuclear power, the fiber accelerometer is tested. The effectiveness of the error stability accelerometers is important for the inertial navigation system. The conventional overhanging accelerometers basically involves the flexible association structure, which constraints the long-term error stability. Hence, this research proposes the Gap Statistics-based K means clustering Method (GS-KCM) for the testing system for the aerospace accelerometer. GS supports to identify the optimal number of clusters through estimating the clustering output of K-Means with that of a random reference distribution. This make sures that the efficient number of clusters is selected without a need of manual selection of the data distribution. The proposed GS-KCM attains the better Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 1.293 and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 1.483 as compared to the conventional approaches like KCM and K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN).

articleTitle: Optimized - Back Propagation approach for Evaluating the Chinese Teaching Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: By accelerating the global combination, the demands from English instruction are growing continuously. The struggle of Chinese English learners for learning the spoken English because of restricted environment in English learning and conditions of teaching in China. The growth of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technique and language teaching and learning methods has new method language teaching and learning. The Optimized - Back Propagation (O-BP) algorithm is developed for Chinese teaching performance evaluation. This approach maintains the highest margin of separation among origin and whole training data samples. The Chinese data are recorded through CoolEdit and it is pre-processed to improve the quality of data. Then, the meaningful features are extracted and it is evaluated by using the O-BP approach. The developed O-BP approach attained 0.3 on 100 nodes, 0.4 on 200 nodes, 0.5 on 300 nodes, 0.6 on 400 nodes and 0.7 on 500 nodes of convergence speed. The developed O-BP approach attained the 0.9543 accuracy while comparing with existing techniques while compared to existing techniques like Back Propagation (BP) approach.

Author Keywords: optimized - back propagation and performance evaluation

articleTitle: Evaluating Quality of College English Classroom Teaching based on Action Recognition using Genetic Algorithm based Multilayer Perceptron
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In these days, enrollment of students in education are rapidly increasing so, teaching quality evaluation need to be addressed. English classrooms should have set of quality teaching activities, feedback procedure is a time taking process and for large-scale classroom analysis, it may not achieve better results. In this paper, Genetic Algorithm based Multilayer Perceptron (GA-MLP) is suggested to evaluate quality of classroom English teaching. The proposed GA-MLP is employed using face expression recognition dataset. Then fast furior transform (FFT) based frequency domain features are extracted from dataset images. Followed by an optimal data clustering method to construct a quality index evaluation system with Delphi method. Principle component analysis is used to remove low-key values and retained high key values for feature dimensionality reduction. The MLP constructs a neural network system and index evaluation system is given as input to generative algorithm to optimize parameters of MLP neural networks. The output layer of MLP with rectified activation function classifies teaching as quality teaching and inferiority teaching.

articleTitle: AI/ML-Based Diabetes Application using Hybrid Grey Wolf and Dipper Throated Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The application of Deep Learning (DL) in diagnosing chronic epidemiological disorders such as diabetes mellitus has become crucial due to the widespread occurrence of this disease worldwide. However, the diagnosis of diabetes faces many challenges such as missing values, high dimensionality of features, and accuracy issues. This paper proposes a Grey Wolf and Dipper Throated Optimization (GWDTO) algorithm for feature selection to address these challenges. The GWDTO algorithm selects relevant features and reduces dimensionality. Initially, data is obtained from the Pima Indian Diabetes Database (PIDD), wherein pre-processing involves handling missing values and normalizing the data by scaling it between the range of 0 and 1. Feature selection using the GWDTO algorithm balances exploration and exploitation to better explore the feature space. The Convolutional Auto encoder (Conv-AE) is then used for classification, after which encoding and decoding of the input data is carried out to capture the underlying structure of the data. The GWDTO algorithm ultimately achieves high accuracy in diabetes diagnosis when compared to the existing techniques namely, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Naïve Bayes. The proposed method achieves a high accuracy of 99.10% on the PIDD dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Ferrite-based Circulator for C-Band Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This study presents comprehensive work on the design and simulation of a ferrite-based circulator optimized for C-band applications, employing the Ansys HFSS tool. Operating specifically at a frequency of 5.5 GHz, the circulator is meticulously engineered to address the unique demands of C-band frequencies. Key performance parameters, including insertion loss, isolation level, return loss, and VSWR, are thoroughly analysed to ensure the circulator’s performance meets stringent standards. Results indicate an insertion loss of 0.315 dB, while isolation levels range from 32.37 dB to 35.98 dB. Return loss varies between 37.19 dB and 51.76 dB, with VSWR measuring at 1.01 dB. The successful design and simulation of this ferrite-based circulator hold significant promise, particularly considering the scarcity of circulators tailored for the C-band. Future endeavors will focus on further optimizing and refining the design for practical integration into C-band systems.

articleTitle: A Graph Neural Network and Transformer Encoder Technique for Anomaly and Cyber Threat Detection in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Nowadays, Smart grids enhance traditional power grids by integrating information and communication technologies for more efficient power delivery and management. However, this integration introduces security vulnerabilities and their exploitation leads to cyber-attacks causing severe consequences like infrastructural damage, massive blackouts. This paper presents an effective approach to detect anomaly and cyber threat in smart grids based on deep learning. A novel Graph Neural Network and Transformer encoder (GNN-Transformer encoder) feature extraction method is proposed in this paper for anomaly and cyber threat identification. Initially, the input data is normalized using min-max normalization technique to transform the data into a common scale. The GNN is utilized for spatial feature extraction which conducts representation learning based on topology of power system. The transformer encoder with self-attention mechanism determines the importance of different time steps and captures long-range dependencies. The fully connected layers provided accurate prediction results by mapping the high-dimensional feature vectors to the final output. The proposed method is evaluated on PMU dataset and achieved high accuracy 97.90%, precision 0.82, recall 0.98. The GNN-Transformer encoder method outperformed existing anomaly detection models such as Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), Spatial Pyramid Pooling with Convolutional Neural Network (SPP-CNN).

articleTitle: Fully Connected Deep Convolutional Neural Network and Improved SURF for Land Cover Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Developing an accurate Land Cover (LC) mapping for efficient land management is crucial to update cover maps for producing sustainable crops. However, extracting accurate features from the LC maps to identify the regions is a challenging task. To overcome this, a Deep Leaning (DL) approach, Fully Connected Deep Convolutional Neural Network and an Improved Speeded Up Robust Features (FCDCNN-ISURF) is proposed for effective feature extraction and selection. Initially the Sentinel Satellite Imagery (Sentinel-2) dataset is pre-processed using Land Surface Water Index (LSWI) which gives the details about soil moisture level from the images. The features are extracted using ISURF for key points detection and description, which is fast and stable to scaling, rotation and illumination. The extracted features are then classified using FCDCNN which classifies the features by pixel-wise prediction. The experimental results on Sentinel-2 dataset showed better LC classification with 98.23% accuracy and 97.70% precision when compared to the results of existing methods such as Shapely Additive Explanation - Convolutional Neural Network (SHAPs-CNN) and Deep Relearning based Recurrent Neural Network (DRRNN) in LC classification.

Author Keywords: fully connected deep convolutional neural network

articleTitle: Metric Generative Adversarial Network with Gated Attention Unit for Text-to-Image Translation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The text-to-image translation is a technique that involves generating visuals accurately representing the details described in the text. However, challenges remain where the produced image cannot completely capture the semantics of text description. Here, the target object in the produced image is incomplete and the texture architecture of the target object lacks richness and detail. In this research, the Metric Generative Adversarial Network (MGAN) with Gated Attention Unit (GAU) method is proposed to translate text to image. The encoder-decoder architecture is developed including the gating blocks utilizing a decoupling style phase-aware technique. This technique estimates the phase data and magnitude of clean data in parallel and effectively minimises interaction between the phase and magnitude. The convolution-augmented gated attention unit is utilized for capturing the time and frequency dependencies with less execution complexity to attain good outcomes. The MGAN with GAU obtains an IS value of 4.42 on Oxford-102 flowers dataset and an IS value of 5.16 on the CUB Bird dataset, which is higher when compared with the Recurrent Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network (RC-GAN).

articleTitle: Automatic Screening system for Mechanical parts using Harris Corner Detection algorithm based Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In recent years, the field of machine vision for automatic screening system is a growing technology of mechanical automation model. However, due to the technological developments in smart factories, the mechanical component inspection and measurement requires efficient precision and accuracy. Therefore, Harris Corner Detection Algorithm based Artificial Neural Networks (HCDA-ANN) are recommended in this research in order to construct an intelligent system. It integrates machine vision and artificial intelligence networks to automatically screening for mechanical components. Using the system calibration, the camera pixel is first calibrated to the actual distance of the object is evaluated. The next step in the measurement and inspection process is to take images and use the Vision 2D model to analyze. Finally, the recommended HCDA-ANN is employed in an automated screening process for mechanical parts to determine whether the metals is non-defective or defective parts. According to the results, it illustrated that the suggested HCDA-ANN method achieved better performance in terms of Mean Square Error (MSE) of 1.55 and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 2.32 which is comparatively higher than existing models namely Design of Experiments (DOE), Zero Defect Manufacturing (ZDM) and Automatic Testing Model (ATM).

articleTitle: FNN-Based Inverse Kinematics for Efficient Trajectory Planning in Industrial Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Industrial robots require precise trajectory planning for optimal performance, particularly when planning in Cartesian space, which demands solving the complex inverse kinematics (IK) problem. Traditional numerical methods for IK are accurate but slow. In contrast, Feedforward Neural Networks (FNNs) offer faster solutions but face challenges in accuracy and training time. This study examines the use of FNNs for task-specific IK with the ABB IRB 6700 robot, aiming for high accuracy and rapid training. The FNN model is trained on desired Cartesian paths and corresponding joint configurations, and its performance is evaluated using Mean Error (ME), Standard Deviation (STD), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE). Results show significantly reduced training times and accurate predictions of joint configurations and Cartesian poses. The FNN's predictions have lower STD values than the robot's path repeatability, demonstrating its potential to enhance real-world trajectory execution.

articleTitle: A Traceability Approach for Agarwood Based on Distributed Identity and Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Hainan agarwood is a valuable commodity with a diverse range of applications, including use in spices, medicines, and cultural artifacts. This has led to the emergence of a growing market for the product. Nevertheless, several challenges persist within the Hainan agarwood industry, including inconsistent product quality, recurrent instances of market fraud, and an opaque supply chain. In order to address these issues, we put forth a proposal for an agarwood traceability method based on Distributed Identity (DID) and smart contracts. The implementation of distributed identity technology enables the assignment of a unique digital identity to each entity within the industrial chain, thereby facilitating enhanced accountability and accurate traceability. Concurrently, smart contract technology is utilized across all links of the industrial chain to achieve comprehensive process information recording and retrieval. This method guarantees that the data associated with each link in the agarwood industry chain is stored on the blockchain in a manner that is immutable. The proposed method effectively identifies counterfeit products while not relying on a single organization, thus reducing the risk of single-point failure and abuse of power, and improving the fairness and credibility of the system.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Predictive Modelling for Sustainable Product Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Silica Fume (FC) is an eco-friendly concrete which is commonly used in construction industry as a building material. With the growing awareness of environmental issues, developing predictive Machine Learning (ML) models becomes most important for optimizing the use of SF in concrete production. This research aims to develop predictive models for Silica Fume Concrete (SFC) properties to enhance Sustainable Product Design (SPD) through ML techniques. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset of SFC, the research focuses on analysing the importance of input selection, isolating six key variables. The feature selection employs an Improved Binary Cuckoo Search Algorithm (IBCSA) enhanced with a Chi-square filter and chaotic map for optimal feature identification. Predictive modelling is done using Decision Trees (DTs), with ensemble methods like bagging and boosting to mitigate overfitting and improve accuracy. The experimental results are validated on SFC and the proposed ML based SPD achieved better accuracy rate at 98.49%, Mean Square Error (MSE) of 1.04, Mean Average Error (MAE) of 0.73 when compared to the results of the existing ML based predictive models such as Gene Expression Programming (GEP) and DT Regression- MultiLayer Perceptron (DTR-MLP).

articleTitle: Triangular Walking Strategy Based Sand Cat Swarm Optimization for Color Level Determination in Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Worldwide, millions of people depend on computer devices, including messaging apps, laptops, and cellphones. Visual Cryptography (VC) is utilized extensively in visual communication systems to secure and encrypting the data in areas such as online transactions, voting, and privacy protection. VC encrypts the secret images and distributes them in to numerous shares, so it ensuring that no single share can reveal the original data. However, current VC methods faces issues like expanding pixel, suboptimal decryption quality, and high computational costs. To address this kind of issues, we introduced novel method leverages (2, 2) secret sharing and integrates the Triangle Walk Strategy based Sand Cat Swarm Optimization (TSCSO) algorithm, specifically introduced for color image encryption in visual communication. TSCSO optimizes the color level selection, it improves the quality of decryption process and reduced the complexity. The scheme maintains the size of shares equal to the original image, avoiding pixel expansion and enhancing both memory utilization and quality of image. The method evaluated with metrics Correlation Coefficient (CC) as 0.0034 and Unified Average Changed Intensity (UACI) as 32.36. Results indicated that this technique enhanced the encryption process compared to other methods like Monarch Butterfly Optimization, Earthworm Optimization and Osprey Optimization Algorithm.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction using Bi-directional Long-Short Term Memory based Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In the area of finance, forecasting of stock price is becoming very popular increasingly. Predicting the stock price of a firm is very important to increase speculators interest in investing for a company and for growth of shareholders in that stock. In addition to a unique investment portfolio model based on the projections produced, this article suggests a novel method for time-series stock price prediction. To achieve this, a Bidirectional Long-Short Term Memory-based Deep Neural Network (Bi-LSTM-DNN) is equipped with novel regression technique. Once made, the predictions are utilized to build investment portfolio, more precisely, a projected portfolio. Numerous tests have been conducted using NIFTY-50 stock data that was acquired from Indian National Stock Exchange. The outcomes verify that suggested model performs better than a number of conventional prediction models and a number of conventional portfolio optimization algorithms. Reducing investing risks and increasing rewards are possible with an accurate stock price prediction. The Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) value for the proposed deep learning network for stock prediction using Bi-LSTM-DNN is 0.81.

articleTitle: Implementation of Predictive Current Control Technique for a 1-Phase 5-Level Switched Capacitor-Based Grid-Connected Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In this paper, a predictive current control technique (PCC) is used as a substitute for direct-quadrature (DQ) control, also called linear control, for a switched capacitor (SC)-based multilevel inverter (MLI) topology. The PCC technique has several advantages over linear control techniques, such as simplicity, low total harmonic distortion (THD), fast dynamic response, and constraint handling. etc. The PCC technique allows the efficient and precise control of active and reactive power, resulting in improved system stability, reduced power losses, and optimal utilization of resources. These advantages were validated by implementing the PCC technique in the SC-based MLI topology. The capacitor was automatically balanced using the given switching states. The results were validated using the MATLAB/Simulink software. The performance indices of the step change in the reference current in the resistance and inductive(R-L) load were analyzed using the simulation results. Specifically, in the grid-connected case, the step change in the power factor and magnitude of the reference current were examined. The simulation outcomes have been presented to demonstrate the fast and efficient dynamic functionality, the negligible level of harmonic content in the current of the grid, and the automatic balancing of the SC.

articleTitle: Athlete Training Movement Recognition using Long Short-Term Memory Model with Adaptive Step Size Based Crow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the rapid growth of recognition technology in images, human action recognition has become increased rapidly, particularly in the context of Athlete Training Movement Recognition (ATMR). This research addresses the challenge of recognizing athlete behaviors in sports teaching videos concentration on the depth frames. In order to improve the recognition accuracy for various athletic behaviors, the research involves extracting and selecting meaningful features from the video frames. The Adaptive Step Size-Based Crow Search Algorithm (ACSA) is employed to select the relevant features from the 4096 extracted VGG-16 deep features and these features are then used to trains a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. LSTM network is adopted to differentiate the action classes and evaluate with performance metrices such as accuracy, Positive Predictive Value (PPV), recall, specificity and F-measure. When compared with other models like Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), proposed model achieved an impressive accuracy of 95.54% in athlete training movement recognition.

Author Keywords: crow search algorithm long short-term memory network

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis on Clustering and Routing Techniques in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) is utilized as front-end communication systems in home automation, environment monitoring, industry, Internet of Things (IoT), etc. The extension of the lifetime of WSNs enhances the utilization of various applications and systems to communicate and interact efficiently. However, cluster heads (CHs) and relay nodes face the difficulties of energy balancing, nodes having limited capability for storage systems, communication, resource management and computational power which further results in corrupted nodes and data becoming vulnerable to improper access. The optimization algorithms namely Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Butterfly Optimization Mechanism (BOM), and Fuzzy Logic (FL)-based techniques are used for reduce the delay in CH selection and routing protocols. This research aims to research the strengths, relationships, and challenges of delay-aware clustering and routing for WSN-based approaches, thereby minimizing the EC and increasing network lifetime.

articleTitle: Integration of Clinical and Imaging Data for Enhancing Oral Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This study aims at unlocking the integration of clinical and imaging data using the deep learning model for enhancing the diagnosis of oral cancer cases. Therefore, for image analysis, in this paper proposed to major on CNNs while for clinical data, our Research used RNNs and hence came up with a unique architecture. The proposed model was trained on the patients’ records and Histopathological Images Database from 5000 patients. As for the overall measure of accuracy of all of the constructed classifiers applying our integrated model the result was 94 %. Specificity achieved for the system was 7% while sensitivity was 93% for the oral cancer. 2%, sensitivity of 69.1%. This is an improvement of the previous methods that required either imaging or clinical data to obtain accuracy approximated at 85-90 percent. As a unique effectiveness factor of increasing the accuracy of oral cancer diagnosis, it is proposed to use an integration of clinical and imaging data through deep learning, which can also result in inclusion of the diagnosis at the early stages of the disease, thereby enhancing the prognosis of the illness.

articleTitle: PropeTrust: Enhancing Land Registration with Ethereum Blockchain and Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Land registration is crucial for modern governance, ensuring property rights, facilitating transactions, and driving economic development. However, traditional systems often face inefficiencies, lack of transparency, and fraud. Blockchain technology offers a solution with its decentralized and immutable ledgers for secure land transactions. This work explores the implementation of blockchain in land registration, emphasizing its potential to enhance security, transparency, and efficiency. Through a review of literature and case studies, various blockchain platforms and consensus mechanisms are evaluated for land registration applications. A novel approach is proposed using the Ethereum blockchain and smart contracts, showcasing the mining of blocks at different stages and a web3 portal for user interactions. The proposed work intends to advance land registration procedures by harnessing the potential of blockchain technology. Blockchain has the ability to transform property rights management by providing a secure, transparent, and tamper-proof platform for documenting land transactions, thereby increasing trust and confidence in land markets.

articleTitle: Attention Based Isolation Forest Integrated Ensemble Machine Learning Algorithm for Financial Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Online card transactions and mobile payment services made easy access for the users to facilitate the payment throughout the world. This attracted the interest of the fraudsters and observed increased cases of fraudulent activities. Many Machine Learning (ML) methods were used to design the Financial Fraud Detection (FFD) system, however extreme class imbalance and high computational complexity negatively affected the performance of the system. The aim of current research is to integrate the Attention Based Isolated Forest (ABIF) with Ensemble Machine Learning (EML) algorithm which includes Random Forest (RF) and AdaBoost (AB). The Paysim financial credit card data is initially pre-processed to perform data scaling and remove the duplicates. The data is sampled using Synthetic Minority Over-sampling TEchnique (SMOTE) for solving data imbalance issues. The relevant features are extracted using Residual Network (ResNet) followed by the feature selection by ABIF method. The final EML based trained FFD model is used for detecting the frauds which resulted in the overall detection accuracy 99.76%, precision of 98.64%, recall of 98.02%, and f1-score of 97.45% which are superior when compared to the existing FFD models namely Random Under Sampling + eXtreme Gradient Boosting (RUS+XGB) and Logistic Regression- RF (LR-RF).

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring of Physical Education Classroom Teaching in Higher Vocational Education Based on Hybrid Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In Physical Education (PE), students struggle with precise movements throughout their early motor skill learning. Correcting and eliminating these inaccurate movements is crucial for teachers to enhance the quality of PE. This research develops an Intelligent Monitoring System (IMS) for PE classroom teaching in higher vocational education based on Deep Learning (DL). In this work, the method of combining MobileNetV3, Single-Shot-Multibox Detector (SSD) and Bi-directional Feature Pyramid Network (Bi-FPN) is used for effective motion detection and feedback. The basis of SSD is MobileNetV3 which is designed for mobile vision tasks, while the Bi-FPN enhances the fusion of features at different scales to enhance motion detection. The system ensures to provide real-time analysis and correction to make a feedback to the students. The overall research provided enhanced performance for mobile application, which leads to the better participation of students and better fitness values. Experimental results showed that the proposed hybrid DL model achieved better accuracy at 99.27%, precision at 97.73%, recall at 98.64%, and error rate at 1.26 when compared to the existing methods such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) regression, and Deep Neural Network (DNN).

articleTitle: Machine Vision-based English Translation Grammar Error Detection Using Temporal Convolutional Network-Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Machine vision-based English translation grammar error detection leverages advanced methods to evaluate and correct errors in translated text. It employs computer vision methods to interpret and increase textual content which enhances translation accuracy and fluency. However, it struggles with context understanding and subtle grammatical nuances because of limited semantic analysis abilities which leads to low accuracy. This research proposes Temporal Convolution Network-Recurrent Neural Network (TCN-RNN) to detect the grammar error in translated text. Initially, the Lang 8 dataset is used to determine the TCN-RNN performance. The stemming and tokenization are applied to remove the unwanted words in translated text. Then, the word2vec approach is performed to extract the pre-processed features effectively. At last, TCN-RNN detect the errors accurately which combines TCN's long-range dependencies whereas RNN manages sequential data which leads to enhanced accuracy in error detection. The proposed TCN-RNN achieves a better accuracy of 97.34% compared to existing methods like TCN-Convolution Neural Network (TCN-CNN) and TCN-Long-Short-Term Memory (TCNN-LSTM) respectively.

articleTitle: Spatial Attention Mechanism Integrated Ensemble Machine Learning for Real Time Prediction and Classification in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Generating spatial and temporal features for real time prediction and classification in precision agriculture is challenging due to inaccurate estimation of features from the remote sensing images. Using Geographical Information System (GIS) and systematic data regarding spatial and temporal data for monitoring and management of agricultural activities. The proposed research integrated GIS and used satellite image processing with Ensemble Machine Learning (EML) algorithms. Initially, the remote sensing data is pre-processed with normalization technique to remove noise. The pre-processed data is given as input to the Improved Speeded Up Robust Features (ISURF) for fast computation and identification of relevant features. The EML algorithms such as Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) are used as a prediction and classification models considering the ISURF features as input. Additionally, the Spatial Attention Mechanism (SAM) is integrated with the EML algorithm to particularly focus on the spatial features of the remote sensing data. The experimental results showed that the proposed SAM-EML achieved precise prediction and classification with 98.30% accuracy, and 97.19% precision when compared to the existing methods Random Forest Regression (RFR) and RF-SVM.

articleTitle: Sports Training Assistance system using Dynamic Data Processing System based Improved Cat Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In recent years, the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and sports applications, computer vision is quickly evolving as a technology. However, the existing models required precise information to be delivered, and it was a crucial task to have several sensor devices. Therefore, a Dynamic Data Processing System (DDPS - ICOA) incorporating an Improved Cat Optimization method is developed in this research for the purpose of recognizing human posture. The model initially integrated the auxiliary teaching system and adjust the standard motion database. The trainers are presented with data that is visually appealing of user movements are related with the conventional actions. With the ability to identify and show video files, the system's overall performances component provides educators with an intelligent teaching platform. According to the results. it illustrated that suggested DDPS - ICOA method achieved better performances in terms accuracy of 99.84%, Efficiency ratio of 98.58% and Error range of 20.27%. which is comparatively higher when compared to existing models such as Hidden Markov Model (HMM), Intelligent Controller System (ICS) and Decision Support Systems (DSS).

articleTitle: Coordinated Multi-Robot Exploration and Slime Mould Algorithm for Multi-Robot Space Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In multi-robot space, conducting research is the critical task to perform flexible without presence of humans the multi-robots are used like landers and rovers for exploring the area which is unknown environment. The multi-robots face problems in exploring the area due improper planning and communication between the robots in specified paths. To solve the problem, Coordinated Multi-robot space Exploration Slime Mould Algorithm (CME-SMA) is proposed here. This integration includes a parallel communication protocol to enhance exploration efficiency and reduce computational complexity. The algorithm focuses on generating optimal collision-free paths in barrier-filled environments by first evaluating neighboring cells using deterministic CME for cost and utility values. SMA is then applied to refine the solutions further. The CME-SMA algorithm is validated through numerous simulations under various environmental conditions, demonstrating consistency in achieving expected outcomes such as exploration rate and time efficiency. The CME-SMA method explored the area is 98.79% with 0 failed run and execution time is 37.15 sec in map 1when compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent Assembly Fiber Optic Sensing System for Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In the field of industrial production, structural components need install in their corresponding positions. When there is interference during the assembly process, it can lead to assembly abnormalities. It’s important to research an automatic intelligent perception system for assembly. An intelligent assembly system based on fiber optic sensing network was studied. It achieves real-time monitoring by FBG, and imports data into the processing module by digital twinning, and reconstruct the field distribution. Designed a technology fusion method based on fiber optic sensing networks and digital twins. The results show that using FBG networking can effectively obtain stress field distribution. In the experiment, stress tests were conducted on 8 mechanical claw positions, and compared with Handscan scanner. The maximum testing errors in the x-axis and y-axis directions are -0.84mm and 0.81mm, respectively. This system can effectively identify stress field changes caused by assembly abnormalities, providing data support for intelligent calibration.

articleTitle: Attention Gate with Bidirectional Long Short-Memory for Crop Type Classification Using Multi-Spectral Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The satellite sensors are used for the monitoring of the crops based on an automated crop detection framework. The Attention Gate with Bidirectional Long Short-Memory (AG-BiLSTM) is developed for crop type classification using multi-spectral satellite images. The min-max normalization is used for preprocessing which scales every feature into common scale because satellite images have different ranges thereby leading different scales of features. The Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used for feature extraction which minimizes the data dimensionality that retains required features when minimizing redundancy and noise. It leads enhanced computational effectiveness and performance through concentrates on significant data. The AG-BiLSTM enhance the capability to concentrate on relevant features which improves classification accuracy. The BiLSTM captures contextual data from both previous and future information which enhance the performance. AG-BiLSTM reached 98.61% of accuracy, 97.49% of precision, 96.28% of recall and 96.88% of f1-score for Sentinel-1 dataset compared to 3D Convolution Neural Network (3D-CNN).

articleTitle: The Application of AES Algorithm in Intelligent Wireless Network Information Security Protection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart wireless network technology, information security is increasingly highlighting its importance. While smart wireless networks provide convenient connectivity and efficient data transmission, they also face unprecedented security challenges.
