These challenges include, but are not limited to, denial-of-service (DoS) attacks, man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks, and malware propagation, etc., which seriously threaten the integrity and confidentiality of network data. This paper first reviews the existing research results in the field of information security of smart wireless networks, which provides a solid theoretical foundation and research background for in-depth analysis. Subsequently, this paper describes in detail how to construct an intelligent wireless network information security protection system based on the AES algorithm, including the system's design ideology, architecture, and specific implementation methods. The system aims to improve the confidentiality and integrity of the data transmission process through AES encryption technology, and effectively resist various types of network attacks. In order to verify the effectiveness and security of the system, a series of experiments are conducted in this paper. The experimental results show that in the face of DoS attack, the encryption speed of the system shows a trend of periodic decline, which reflects the impact of the attack on the system performance. The fluctuation of encryption speed is even more irregular under MitM attacks, which further highlights the complexity and difficulty of defending against such attacks. It was found that the information security protection system for smart wireless networks based on the AES algorithm demonstrated different performance in the face of different types of network attacks. Specifically, DoS attacks lead to periodic decreases in encryption speed, while MitM attacks cause more irregular fluctuations in encryption speed, revealing the complexity of the attacks and the difficulty of defending against them. Meanwhile, malware propagation, although having less impact on encryption speed, was still observed to fluctuate periodically, reflecting malware activity patterns and the effectiveness of network defence measures. These findings provide important empirical support for information security protection in smart wireless networks.

articleTitle: Ant Colony Algorithm for Solving Multi-objective Optimization Problems in Software Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With multi-objective becoming more and more important, ant colony algorithm has become an ideal tool to solve multi-objective optimization problems because of its unique positive feedback and distributed computing characteristics. This study explores the application of ant colony algorithm and its variants in multi-objective optimization problems of software engineering, especially the performance of ant colony system, and compares it with hybrid ant colony algorithm (HACO) and adaptive ant colony algorithm (AACO). The experimental results show that ACS is superior to AACO and HACO in convergence, execution time and solution set coverage. In particular, the maximum generation distance (GD) of ACS is only 0.2; The maximum execution time is 522ms, and the coverage rate is 80.3%-96.7%. These results confirm the outstanding performance of ACS algorithm in solving multi-objective optimization problems in software engineering.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis in PV Integrated Distribution System using Wavelet and Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Solar energy is clean and renewable, significantly reducing carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gas emissions compared to fossil fuel-based energy sources. PV integrated distribution systems offer a wide array of benefits, from reducing environmental impact and energy costs to enhancing grid reliability and promoting technological innovation. The integration of photovoltaic (PV) systems into the distribution network introduces new challenges in maintaining reliable and efficient operation, primarily due to the intermittent nature of solar energy and the potential for various faults. This paper explores advanced methodologies for fault diagnosis in PV-integrated distribution systems by leveraging Wavelet Transform and Data Mining techniques. The proposed approach is validated through extensive simulations and real-world data analysis, demonstrating its capability to effectively diagnose common faults such as line-to-ground faults, arc faults, and partial shading. The integration of these techniques enhances the fault detection process, offering a robust, scalable, and automated solution for maintaining the integrity and performance of PV-integrated distribution systems. The proposed method yields 99.3% fault detection accuracy and it indicates a significant improvement in fault detection accuracy and response time, thereby contributing to the reliability and sustainability of renewable energy distribution networks. The proposed method is compared with methods that available in literature.

articleTitle: Sign Language Conversion into Text and Speech using Flex Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Translates sign language into text and speech using flex sensors, back ground: This work aim to bring or develop system that translates sign language gestures into written and spoken language, through utilizing hard ware compounds which recognise hand movement and convert into corresponding text and speech, this initiative seeks to enhance communication for deaf and hard of hearing community, it enables real time interaction problem allowing sign language user to interact with another community effectively, Method: Implementation of this Concept involves wearable gloves embedded with flex sensors to capture sign language gestures, which further processed using algorithm to translate them into text and speech, additionally Bluetooth modulator which transmit the processed data wirelessly, It ensures efficient and reliable data transmission (multi senser fusion, IOT) result: expected out come is real time, accurate translation that enhance greatly accessibility, inclusivity and independence for deaf community. Concluding remarks ensure equal access to information and opportunities, raise awareness between deaf community. Out comes are providing real time communication aids in public spaces, work spaces, educational institutions and also use for learning tool for both sign language user and learner.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Tourist Satisfaction Based Light Gradient Boosting Machine Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In recent years, tourist satisfaction has become a focus as the population has become a key factor in the economic development of those regions. A good understanding of what exactly needs to be done to improve public transport services is key to a city’s attractiveness. The research aimed at a sample population of 1019 tourists, consisting of foreign origin and local residents, through a stratified sampling method and open-ended survey questions. Discussing data mining, for example, multidimensional analysis and clustering visualization, intersects with survey data to generate insights. Furthermore, a supervised light gradient boosting (LGBM) algorithm of Machine Learning (ML) is proposed to develop a predictive model that assigns tourists to satisfied, neutral, and dissatisfied categories, respectively. A highly successful model will be developed as a learning-facilitating framework and serve as a predictive tool for audience satisfaction ratings. The proposed method obtains the more efficient in accuracy of 97.4%, precision of 97.5%, recall of 97.4% and specificity of 98.9% from the existing methods.

articleTitle: Attention based ConVnet-Recurrent Neural Network for Facial Recognition and Emotion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Facial Emotion Recognition (FER) plays a crucial role in analysing and understanding individual’s emotions in the form of non-verbal communication. Existing Deep Learning (DL) based FER methods offered diverse contribution in analysing human emotions but several challenges like extracting accurate spatial and temporal features for accurate classification of emotions is a major concern. To address this, a DL based Facial Recognition and Emotion Detection (FRED) system is proposed by using extended Cohn-Kanade (CK+) dataset as the input. The data is pre-processed first where the Histogram Equalization (HE) is applied and then Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used to extract the spatial features while reducing the dimensionality. The extracted features are given to Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to learn long term dependencies from a temporal sequence of data. The final classification is performed where the Attention Mechanism (AM) is integrated in the RNN to determine the higher weights for better outcome. The results of proposed AMConVnet-RNN showed a superior classification accuracy of 99.54%, precision of 98.63%, and f1-score of 97.39% when compared to existing FER methods like Residual Network-50 (ResNet-50) and Channel Based Attention Mechanism (CBAM) based ResNet50.

articleTitle: Construction of Computer Network Management System based on NETCONF and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer network technology, traditional network management methods face many challenges. This paper proposes a network management system based on NETCONF and decision tree algorithm to improve network performance and stability through automatic configuration and intelligent fault diagnosis. The experimental results show that the system performs outstandingly in network fault diagnosis, with an average diagnosis time of 30 seconds and an accuracy rate of 96%, which is significantly better than that of the traditional method (average time of 66 seconds and accuracy rate of 72.4%). This proves that the system has significant advantages in improving the efficiency and adaptability of network management. Future research will explore more comprehensive network security integration strategies and optimization of the system's adaptive capabilities.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Cloud and Internet of Things-Based Disease Detection Approach for Secure Healthcare system
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The role of the Internet of Things (IoT) in disease data handling, analysis, prediction, and classification is prominent due to digital electronic healthcare records (EHRs). This article introduces a secure EHR handling scheme for disease detection and classification from the observed data. First, the data transmission is secured through forward two-way authentication and its integrity is verified on the receiving end. The extracted EHR data is correlated with the clinical observations to detect the disease. This scheme therefore relies on maximum data integrity to ensure high disease detection through uninterrupted patient data transmission. As a result, the proposed scheme enhanced the integrity verification by 14.31% and increased the accuracy of disease detection by 11.73% across various accumulation periods. The data correlation and transmission are verified and validated using IoT and its associated technologies for improving the disease detection ratio.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Authentication Techniques for Internet of Medical Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) is a rapidly expanding field in the healthcare industry, aimed at improving patient care. It strives to accomplish this by combining network technology with medical equipment. Nevertheless, serious security and privacy issues are raised by integration, especially affecting authentication of the patient data stored in the cloud storage system. Block-chain technology is unchangeable and decentralized, and hence becomes an efficient solution to mitigate the above problems. Many blockchain-based authentication methods for IoMT are investigated. This survey examines various blockchain based authentication techniques along with their efficacy, scalability, and flexibility, thus evaluating their contributions to safe and effective authentication procedures for IoMT. To demonstrate real-world applications and results, comparative analysis is explored. In order to improve the security and dependability of IoMT systems, this study aims to assist researchers in creating blockchain-based authentication methods by offering an in-depth review.

articleTitle: Grammar Error Correction in English-Chinese Translation using Gaussian Mixture Distribution based K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The translation process involved English – chinses grammar error correction by using Machine Learning (ML) technique is analysis basic principles and particular strategies of language translation. However, sensitive to analysis English – chinses grammar correction which cause the model to perform less accuracy, when data is noisy due to difficult to analysis the text feature. This paper, proposed Gaussian Mixture Distribution based on K-means clustering (GMD based K-means) technique for classification is efficiently classify the error correction it help to achieve the better accuracy. The GMD based K-means is handle overlapping clusters more effectively because they model data distribution using Gaussian distribution which capture the text feature efficiently. Initially data obtained from English-Chinese Bilingual Parallel Corpora (ECBPC) dataset and pre-processing including normalization is used to address the large gap between values of different dimension in text data. The feature extraction using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) is applied to reduce Nosie in data and improve quality of feature representation. The proposed GMD based K-means method is evaluated using ECBPC data achieving a higher accuracy of 92.45% respectively. The existing techniques such as Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Generalized LR (GLR) are evaluated of proposed method.

Author Keywords: gaussian mixture distribution based k-means clustering
support vector machine and term frequency-inverse document frequency

articleTitle: Adaptive Inertia Weight with Whale Optimization Algorithm for Mathematical Models in Energy Saving Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The global manufacturing industry there is increasing the recognition of need to enhance energy efficiency to reduce both costs and accuracy. However, achieving accurate energy control is challenging due to the dynamic performance requirements and the need for precise installation of variable displacement pumps or frequency conversion equipment. This paper, proposed Adaptive Inertia Weight with Whale Optimization Algorithm (AIW-WOA) method is efficiently performed in the energy efficiency in refrigeration plant to achieve better accuracy balance energy. The adaptive mechanism of the inertia weight adjusts based on the iteration process to evaluated the refrigeration of the flexible to changing energy level condition is mathematically represented. The AIW mechanism allow the optimization process to adapt to different operational condition in refrigeration plant such as varying load demand and energy. The proposed AIW-WOA method for energy saving efficient in refrigeration is achieving better outcomes such as accuracy of 92.12% respectively. The existing method such as Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Asymmetric Hydraulic Cylinder (AHC) are evaluated for proposed method.

Author Keywords: adaptive inertia weight with whale optimization algorithm
energy saving efficiency and genetic algorithm

articleTitle: English Translation Assistance System Integrating Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: As computer-assisted translation systems become integral to daily life and learning, various issues have emerged, such as whether existing systems can deliver accurate translations across different sentence structures and lengths. This study focuses on optimizing neural machine translation technology to tackle challenges like low-resource language pairs and limited parallel corpora. We introduced an unsupervised neural machine translation model and assessed its performance based on BLEU scores, translation speed, loss value, translation accuracy, and average vocabulary similarity. The results revealed that the model excelled in semantic understanding and alignment, with an average similarity between 0.76 and 0.81. The model showed substantial improvements in translation performance, offering a novel approach to advancing neural machine translation technology.

articleTitle: Center Intersection of Union loss with You Only Look Once for Object Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The main aim of object detection is to extract the feature for different sizes trough hierarchically stacking the multiple scale feature maps. The 2 Dimension (2D) object detection is the difficult in facilitates the perceptron system to knowing the environment. Though, that is not easy for deciding the transmit semantic data to low-level layers when minimizing loss of semantic data of high-level features. In this research, the Center Intersection of Union loss with You Only Look Once (CIoU-YOLO) method for detecting the objects. The datasets used for detecting the objects are MS-COCO 2017 and KITTI and the images in the dataset are pre-processed by using the point clouds. Then, the detection is performed by using the CIoU – YOLO v5 method. The new loss function is introduced in the YOLO v5 which improves the performance of object detection. The CIoU-YOLO v5 method attained the Average Precision (AP) of 44.7% on MS-COCO 2017 dataset and 53.7% AP on KITTI dataset which is superior than Dual-path Lightweight Module (DLM).

Author Keywords: semantic data and you only look once

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Digital Currency Payment System based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Against the backdrop of the rapid development of the digital economy, block chain has shown broad application prospects in the field of electronic currency due to its characteristics of transparency, security, and decentralization. On this basis, a prototype of an electronic currency payment system based on Ethernet can be constructed by combining existing theories and application foundations, and its operational efficiency and security have been empirically tested. In the design of the system, intelligent contracts can be used to automate transaction processing and verification, reducing the possibility of human error and deception. The block confirmation time increased from 2.0 seconds to 4.5 to 4.7 seconds, indicating that higher network latency prolonged the confirmation process of transactions in the blockchain, which had an impact on the real-time nature of transactions and user experience. Through testing, it has been proven that this new type of e-commerce platform has good operational efficiency and security performance, and has good application prospects.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Video Storage System Based on H.266/VVC Encoding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The cost of obtaining ultra-high definition videos has significantly decreased, bringing about explosive data growth. The H.266/VVC standard can handle a wider range of video formats and content, providing an efficient, flexible, and unified encoding and compression framework for existing and emerging video applications. The research method of this article is based on the H.266/VVC encoding framework, studying the four parameter and six parameter affine motion compensation prediction mathematical models, and constructing a layered architecture of a digital video storage system consisting of terminal layer, application layer, functional layer, support layer, and data layer. A comparative experiment was conducted between H.266/VVC and H.265/HEVC, including technical and compression cost comparisons. The results showed that the compression cost based on the H.266VVC encoding algorithm was much lower than that of the H.265/HEVC encoding algorithm, avoiding problems such as image lag, format incompatibility, and audio misalignment in compressed digital videos. This solved the problems of cumbersome digital video compression coding and excessive CPU load, and significantly improved compression coding efficiency.

articleTitle: A Method to Detect Amphetamine Addiction using Shallow Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Drug addiction is a critical issue, necessitating actions to prevent severe physical and mental health problems. Among all drug addictions, amphetamine addiction rank third in addictive substances according to WHO. In this work, a method has been suggested for amphetamine addiction detection. The input features used to detect the amphetamine addiction are personality features and demographic features. The features are then selected using random forest method. Out of all features, fifteen features are selected except the N-score. The selected features are then given to deep neural network for detecting amphetamine addiction. The sensitivity, specificity and accuracy of the proposed method has been found to be 0.97, 0.86 and 0.92 respectively. The precision, recall and F1-score of the proposed method has been found to be 0.87, 0.97 and 0.92 respectively. The proposed method can be used as an assisting tool for counselling addicted individuals.

articleTitle: Domain Adaptive based Convolutional Neural Network for Change Detection using Time Series Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The Change Detection (CD) is the process of observing the transition of the earth’s surface which is crucial in urban areas. Existing methods showed various developments in CD using Deep Learning (DL) models, however, they are limited to learn the image features only in one domain. To overcome this, the proposed research developed a Domain Adaptive (DA) based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for CD (DA-CNN-CDNet). The time series satellite images from the Sentinel-2 are collected and pre-processed by applying pixel-level and spatial-level transforms for effective training of the model. The features are extracted using Pseudo-Siamese with non-weights and fed to the CNN. The CNN is trained in DA environment to apply the knowledge that CNN has learnt in one domain to one or more other domains which enhances the CD. The experimental results of the proposed DA-CNN-CDNet showed better CD with 99.76% of accuracy, 99.18% of precision, 98.62% of recall, and 97.98% of f1-score when compared to existing methods Cross Layer Convolutional Neural Network (CLNet) and Local Similarity Siamese Network (LSS-Net).

articleTitle: Detection and Recognition of Professional English Texts using One Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network and Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Texts appear with many script combinations, in various orientations, sizes, colours, and backdrops. It is crucial to recognise English text accurately and quickly from a wide range of inputs to address the challenges related to complex backgrounds and handwriting variations. A two-hidden-layer 1 Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (1DCNN) is applied to extracts features from input images. The two hidden layers consists of input network with two convolution layers, and the layer has network with Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) block to focus on the significant features. The batch normalization to match the distribution while the max-pooling layers perform the down sampling The output of the two networks are concatenated and fed to Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) network which decodes features considering of forward and backward dependencies. The last layer is the Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) layer which gives out the final text recognition output. Results showed that the proposed 1DCNN-Bi-GRU model showed better detection and recognition accuracy of professional English texts with 98.29%, precision of 96.34%, and recall 95.33% when compared to the existing models You Only Live Once v3 (YOLOv3) and Deep Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (DCRNN).

Author Keywords: detection and recognition of professional english texts

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm for Learning Resource Library based on VLC/RF Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the development of emerging information technology, the connotation and extension of digital learning resources have been greatly expanded. The digital learning resource platform plays an important bridging role between teachers and students, and its quality directly affects the learning effectiveness of teachers. In the era of intelligence, the development of digital learning resource platforms should focus on the quality evaluation of resources, analyze the significant characteristics of different digital stages, focus on user experience, and meet the diverse needs of users. This article is based on the VLC/RF (Visible Light Communication/Radio Frequency) hybrid system, and studies the method of optimizing the digital learning resource library. The quality of the digital learning resource platform is evaluated based on the needs and satisfaction of teachers. Through experimental analysis, the impact of different bandwidth allocation, number of users, and network load on system performance was studied. The results showed that when the VLC bandwidth and RF bandwidth were 10 MHz and 20 MHz, respectively, the system throughput was 110 Mbps and the delay was 7 ms. Reasonable bandwidth allocation and control of user numbers and network load can significantly improve system performance, balance the balance between system energy efficiency and performance, and provide important references for the optimization of VLC/RF hybrid systems.

articleTitle: Predicting Natural Hazards and Disaster Risks using Improved Particle Swarm Optimization based Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Predicting natural hazards before its occurrence is crucial to reduce the impact it causes economically to the cities/areas. Therefore, advanced Machine Learning (ML) models can be used to manage disasters by performing an early detection of hazards susceptible locations. The geographical data on natural hazards is collected pre-processed to eliminate the null values. The data is applied with the normalization technique and performed data scaling to transform all the variables to the same range. To obtain complex hierarchical features, Residual Network (ResNet) is used and the extracted features are selected using Attention Based Isolated Forest (ABIF) to solve the standard linear or quadratic optimization problem. To obtain the optimal solution in predicting the natural hazards the parameters of Support Vector Machine (SVM) are optimised using Improved Particle Swarm Optimization (IPSO). This ensures the model’s generalization and predictive ability and to handle high dimension data. The results showed that the proposed IPSO-SVM achieved better prediction accuracy with 98.59%, and precision of 97.74% when compared to the conventional ML methods such as Natural Gradient Boosting Machines (NGBoost) and AdaBag- Nearest Shrunken Centroids (AB-NSC).

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Energy Consumption Algorithm for Ocean Oil and Gas IoT Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The management of offshore oil and gas is becoming more and more important. In this study, firstly, the data collected in the offshore oil and gas Internet of Things are prepared, including data cleaning and data standardization, to ensure the quality of input data. Next, a CNN model composed of convolution layer, aggregation layer and full connection layer is designed and constructed. These layers work together and are responsible for feature extraction and accurate prediction of future energy consumption trends. From the research results, the algorithm has obviously improved the energy saving rate and recall rate. The highest recall rate of CNN model can be as high as 95%, which is obviously better than the highest values of recurrent neural network (RNN) and long-term and short-term memory network (LSTM), which are 85% and 80% respectively. This proves the excellent ability of CNN model to identify abnormal energy consumption.

articleTitle: Sports Action Recognition and Standardized Training using Puma Optimization Based Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Trainers/coaches in sports show high standards for their skill because they provide key training tips to students for achieving own goals by focusing their performances. To automate that activity, applying artificial intelligence technology to the field of sports training, a sports action recognition combined training method is proposed utilizing an Optimized Deep Learning (DL) mechanism named Puma Optimization based Residual Network (PO-ResNet) model. The ResNet is used for recognizing the action and the PO is used for tuning the hyperparameters of ResNet to improve recognition accuracy. Utilizing wearable sensors, the system records the user’s motion data, then the mix-max normalization technique is used to preprocess the signal by removing unwanted noises to perform Sport action recognition effectively. Then, the proposed PO-ResNet optimization model extracts the features and recognition the user’s activities effectively. Subsequently, the PO-ResNet enables the user to standardize sports combination training. The suggested PO-ResNet technique produced good recognition accuracy of 98.97% and outperforms conventional approaches such as Convolutional Neural Network, Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory and ResNet (BiLSTM+ResNet) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU).

articleTitle: Digital Library Network Anomaly Detection System based on Situation Awareness
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The cloud computing platform of the smart library is designed to achieve functions such as collecting, transmitting, processing, and storing massive data. In order to ensure the normal operation of the smart library business application system, cloud computing architecture is generally adopted. Cloud computing data centers carry massive amounts of data and network devices, and the massive data information accumulated during their storage and transmission processes may be destroyed. Once attacked, the consequences would be very serious. Meanwhile, cloud computing and virtualization technologies pose new challenges to the security of smart library data centers. Traditional information security defense systems can no longer meet the security protection requirements of smart libraries for information systems. Therefore, in order to ensure the information security of smart libraries, it is necessary to break through the shortcomings of existing information security defense systems and provide effective support for them. Therefore, this article explored a network anomaly situation awareness model based on PCA-BP algorithm to detect the abnormal status of digital library networks. The experimental results showed that when DOS attack was used in the experiment, the prediction accuracy of the BP algorithm model was 0.883, while the prediction accuracy of the PCA-BP (Principal Component Analysis-Back Propagation) algorithm was 0.94.

articleTitle: Utilization of Intelligent Optimization Algorithms in Geological Prospecting Seismic Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In geological exploration, the accuracy of seismic data analysis is pivotal. Traditional methods struggle with high-dimensional data, leading to inaccuracies. This study introduces the Differential Evolution algorithm to enhance analysis precision and efficiency through preprocessing, feature selection, and optimization. The DE algorithm outperforms conventional methods in feature identification and anomaly detection, achieving up to 95.6% accuracy. It also demonstrates robustness across various signal-to-noise ratios and seismic events, particularly under high ratios, maintaining 95.6% robustness. Moreover, it excels in efficiency, reducing data processing and training times significantly compared to traditional approaches. The DE algorithm offers valuable insights and tools for geological exploration, promising significant contributions to future resource development.

articleTitle: Levy distribution-based Dung Beetle Optimization with Support Vector Machine for Sentiment Analysis of Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The social media platforms such as Facebook and Twitter have increasingly popular to express their opinions on various topics. These platforms have emerged as efficient and largest source for collecting public opinion. Therefore, Levy distribution-based Dung Beetle Optimization (LDBO) with Support Vector Machine (SVM) is proposed for sentiment analysis. The LDBO enhances the exploration abilities which enables to search solution space effectively and avoids local optima. The SVM is efficient to find optimal hyperplane which reduces the margin among classes thereby leads classification performance. Moreover, SVM is useful with various kernel function which enables to capture non-linear relationship in data thereby enabling better generalization in unseen data. The Term Frequency-Inverse Component Frequency (TF-ICF) is helpful for differentiating among positive and negative sentiments. Moreover, it reduces the commonly occurred words and concentrates on informative terms. The preprocessing includes filtering, normalization, stemming, stop word removal and tokenization which enhances the quality and model performance. The SVM achieves better in terms of 98.65% accuracy, 98.12% precision, 97.36% recall and 97.73% f1-score compared to Gated Attention Recurrent Network (GARN).

articleTitle: Information Network Security Situation Awareness Based on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In the face of increasingly complex network environments, this study aims to improve the ability of information network security situation awareness. Through artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies based on the isolation forest (IF) algorithm, a multi-level and modular security situation awareness framework is constructed. The framework integrates deep learning, natural language processing and adaptive learning technologies to perform indepth analysis and feature extraction on multi-source data to improve the detection, identification and response capabilities of network threats. Experimental results show that the framework exhibits high detection accuracy and an average response time of less than 100 seconds in standardized tests, and effectively responds to emergencies through adaptive learning modules. Multiple simulated network attack scenarios verify the performance and reliability of the framework under different conditions. The research results establish the effectiveness of the isolation forest algorithm in information network security and show advantages in key indicators such as false alarm rate, accuracy, detection delay and true negative rate. Future research will continue to explore the integration of multi-source information to improve recognition performance in complex network environments.

articleTitle: Real-time Streaming Media Processing and Optimization Technology in Intelligent Video Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the public Internet becoming more unstable due to issues like network congestion and line outages, ensuring the quality of large-scale real-time communications is becoming a significant concern. The real-time streaming processing and optimization methods for intelligent video surveillance systems are the main topics of this study. It offers a dynamic routing and distribution network technology developed to address transmission issues brought on by unstable public Internet links. Transmission quality is significantly increased by the system's optimisation of data transfer between servers through the use of dynamic path design and real-time quality detection. The study shows increased transmission stability and efficiency by contrasting static direct connections with dynamic routing. The dynamic obstacle avoidance capabilities of the system is validated by experimental simulations of network breakdowns. Furthermore, the effectiveness of different video encoders and streaming transport methods is assessed. According to the findings, content-aware coding beats rate-control and resolution-adjustment approaches in terms of video transmission quality, achieving an average Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) of 38.2 dB. The present study offers significant perspectives on enhancing real-time streaming services and contributes to the advancement of intelligent video surveillance systems in the future.

articleTitle: Dance Performance Recognition and Analysis Based on Pulse Coupled Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Dance is universally recognized expressive movement and it requires ongoing training and accurate evaluations to improve the expression and performance. The existing method struggled with capturing spatial data due to its long-term dependencies. Therefore, this research proposes a Pulse Coupled Neural Network (PCNN) for dance performance recognition. The PCNN is robust to noise which ensures the network to concentrate on essential features of dance moments and enhancing the recognition accuracy. It has capability to mimic the visual cortex behavior which is helpful to recognize image structures. The Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) is used to extract shape and gradient features which is useful for shape pattern recognition. The Indian dance form recognition dataset is preprocessed by data augmentation which enhances the data size and prevent overfitting issues by introducing changes such as flips, rotations and translations. The PCNN achieved 99.95%, 99.66%, 99.52%, 99.93% and 98.16% of accuracy, f1-measure, precision, recall and AUC metrics compared to Fusion Neural Network (FUSNN).

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System Using Long-Short-Term Memory with Mish Activation Function in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Intrusion Detection System (IDS) in cloud involves the monitoring and analyzing of system activities and network traffic to determine the unauthorized access or malicious behavior. IDS is significant in protecting sensitive data while maintaining the security and integrity of cloud resources. However, the IDS in cloud face struggles with accurately classifying complex, evolving the attack patterns because of the dynamic nature of cloud infrastructure and huge data volume. This research proposes Long-Short-Term Memory with Mish Activation Function (LSTM-MAF) to detect the intrusions accurately. LSTM-MAF enhances the complex detection, non-linear patterns, as well as the model’s adaptability by evolving threats which leads to a reliable and accurate performance. Initially, the NSL-KDD and CSE-CIC-IDS2018 datasets are used to evaluate the model’s performance. Min-max normalization normalizes the data in the pre-processing phase that preserves relationships in data. Then, the Honey Badger Algorithm (HBA) is established to select the most appropriate features effectively. The proposed LSTM-MAF achieves a better accuracy of 99.871% and 99.94% using NSL-KDD and CSE-CIC-IDS2018 datasets when compared to the existing methods namely, Hybrid Network-based IDS (HNIDS) and Correlation-based F-Differential Evolution (CFS-DE).

Author Keywords: long-short-term memory with mish activation function

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Crime Prevention in Smart Cities Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Crime prevention in smart city infrastructure significantly impacts improving quality of human life. However, the substantial increase in the urban population in recent years affects accuracy, safety, and security. This paper presents a solution using the Hyperplane to improve the Radial Basis Function with Support Vector Machine (SVM) based on Machine Learning techniques to enhance accuracy, safety, and security. The SVM method aims to reduce crime rates through proactive measures based on predictive insights. The RBF kernel handles nonlinear relationships by mapping input features into a higher-dimensional space, allowing the model to capture complex patterns. Initially, data is obtained from the Chicago crime dataset and pre-processed by checking for missing values and performing feature scaling to ensure consistency. Feature selection is conducted using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to identify relevant features from the data. Crime prediction using RBF with SVM is performed efficiently to enhance accuracy. The proposed RBF-SVM model is evaluated using the Chicago crime dataset, achieving a high accuracy of 0.89, a precision of 0.80, a recall of 0.82, and an F1-score of 0.85. The performance is compared to existing techniques such as Decision Tree (DT) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM).

Author Keywords: radial basis function and support vector machine

articleTitle: An Analysis of Light Weight Symmetric Encryption Algorithms for Secure Data Transmission in IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) consists of a network of resource-constrained devices, sensors, and machines that are interconnected and communicate via the internet. However, these devices often struggle while handling complex attacks during data encryption and after the encrypted data is transmitted. Cipher algorithms are therefore critical to the data security process because they handle the growing complexities in the applications of data environments. This review aims to present the most effective and efficient symmetric cipher algorithms, which use the same components as the ciphers. It demonstrates how the current cipher has developed into a lightweight encryption by lowering the number and impact of each component. Thus, it becomes clearer how the strength of these components varies between symmetric and asymmetric ciphers dependent on their size. Finally, several efficient lightweight symmetric cipher algorithms are selected, and the security, performance, and resource needs of each algorithm's components are reviewed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Internet Platform Supply Chain Management based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The field of supply chain management is undergoing profound changes. Machine learning algorithms, especially Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM), show great potential in processing time series data and optimizing supply chain management. The purpose of this study is to explore the application of LSTM in the supply chain management of Internet platform, and compare it with Random Forest (RF) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). By comparing inventory turnover rate, order fulfillment cycle time and perfect order rate, the performance of different algorithms in supply chain management was evaluated. Research methods include the description of algorithm principle, the collection and pretreatment of supply chain data, model design, training and evaluation. The final data showed that the inventory turnover rate of LSTM was up to 97.6%; the order fulfillment cycle time of LSTM was kept at a low level, ranging from 3.3 days to 6.3 days; the perfect order rate was up to 87.8%. The conclusion of this study provides theoretical and practical guidance for the intelligentization of supply chain management in the future.

articleTitle: Enhancing Video Frame Interpolation using Modified GAN Architecture: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Video frame interpolation (VFI) leverages Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to enhance interpolation quality, resulting in smoother transitions and slow-motion effects. Our modified Down-Up GAN architecture improves temporal connections, yielding higher-quality results. Experimental findings on the Vimeo-90K and UCF101 datasets, along with real-world CCTV footage, demonstrate substantial improvements in PSNR and SSIM parameters. Specifically, our proposed method achieves a PSNR of 38.89 and SSIM of 0.97 on Vimeo-90K, outperforming previous methods. Additionally, on UCF101, we attain a PSNR of 35.49 and SSIM of 0.905. Evaluation on CCTV footage yields a PSNR of 41.53 and SSIM of 0.982, highlighting robustness across datasets and real-world scenarios. These results indicate promising avenues for future research, including optimizing for real-time applications and exploring attention processes and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to enhance accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Planning Based on Adaptive Weight Factor based White Shark Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The planning of power grid is significant for the development of the power system. A distribution network has progressed from the individual to the multi-source multidirectional network, enhancing the operational and planning complexity. However, due to the non-linear nature of most of the loads, there is significant demand for the reactive power in the distribution network. Hence, this research proposes the Adaptive Weight Factor based White Shark Optimization (AWF-WSO) approach for the optimal planning of the distributed networks. Through effectively adapting the weight factor, the WSO considers the cleansing high-quality solutions, leads to more accurate and reliable planning results. For load estimations, a Backward Forward Sweep (BFS) approach is performed as the experimental setup to perform network effectiveness, focussing a power controlling constraints. The experimental results shows that the proposed AWF-WSO approach attains the minimum Iterative algebra at convergence of 28, fitness value of 1.05 and Computational time of 118s respectively as compared to the existing method like WSO.

articleTitle: Construction of a 3D Indoor Aging Friendly Design System based on Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The aging of the global population makes the age-friendly design a hot topic in the design field and society. A three-dimensional indoor elderly friendly design system based on adaptive genetic algorithm is proposed to create a safe, comfortable and convenient living environment for the elderly. This paper introduces the construction of adaptive genetic algorithm, including population initialization, parameter setting, adaptive mechanism and fitness function design. In addition, this paper also analyzes the requirements of aging-friendly design, and transforms these requirements into quantifiable design parameters, which are encoded into the chromosomes of genetic algorithm. The experimental results show that the processing time of AGA is obviously lower than that of SGA, the accuracy reaches 98.8%, and the stability remains above 90.6%. The user satisfaction score reaches 9.9, which shows the potential of the system in providing high-quality design solutions.

articleTitle: A UAV-Based Remote Sensing Image Automatic Monitoring System Empowered by Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In this study, an automatic monitoring system based on convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed to address the automation and accuracy of remote sensing image processing. With the maturity and wide application of remote sensing and UAV technologies, efficient and accurate image analysis methods have become particularly important. We developed this system through in-depth research on multiple stages of data preprocessing, feature extraction and model training. In the experimental stage, through the comparison experiments with Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest (RF) models, it is found that the CNN model has significant advantages in processing speed, anti-interference ability and accuracy. Especially in the processing of urban remote sensing images, CNN exhibits up to 90% accuracy, showing its wide applicability and excellent cross-domain application capability. Overall, this study not only successfully develops an efficient and accurate automatic monitoring system for remote sensing images, but also provides strong theoretical and experimental support for future optimization of CNN architecture in natural environments, improvement of real-time data processing capability, and extension to practical applications such as disaster monitoring and environmental protection.

articleTitle: Research on Object Detection Method Based on Improved Multi-Feature Fusion in Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Facing the complex construction environment on the construction site, forklift operations may lead to accidental casualties, so it is crucial to automatically recognizing forklifts and avoid construction workers from entering hazardous areas to enhance construction safety. In this study, single-stage target detection approach YOLOv5 is firstly improved by replacing the original FPN with BiFPN, which promotes the fusion between different features and improves the expressive ability of the features. Meanwhile, the post-processing in the YOLOv5 is improved for enhancing detection accuracy of forklift recognition frame. Subsequently, this study proposed an improved YOLOv5 forklift automatic recognition algorithm based on the improved YOLOv5 algorithm to further enhance detection performance while ensuring detection speed. In addition, a new forklift vehicle dataset was created. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this study improves the accuracy of forklift detection, and the mAP is improved by 1.97% compared with the traditional YOLOv5 algorithm, and the recognition effect is significantly improved, which proves the effectiveness of the new algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Intelligent Wireless Pond/Lake Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This River pollution is a major environmental problem that has serious problems for human health, aquatic life, and the overall health of ecosystems. Floating garbage is a complicated problem to address, as it can be difficult to collect and remove from rivers and other waterways. Wireless river-cleaning robots can potentially be a valuable tool for addressing this problem. These robots can be equipped with a variety of sensors and actuators to detect and collect floating garbage, without the need for human efforts. This can help to reduce the cost and environmental impact of river cleaning operations, while also improving the effectiveness of these efforts. This paper aims to design and develop a wireless river-cleaning robot that is capable of autonomously detecting and collecting floating garbage. The robot will be designed with a variety of sensors, including cameras, ultrasonic sensors, and water quality sensors. Image processing will be used to identify floating garbage, as well as to avoid obstacles and navigate the river safely. The robot will also be equipped with a collection system that can collect floating garbage and other debris. The robot will be controlled wirelessly using image processing and data will be stored on the website. This paper helps to reduce the water pollution on floating bodies and saves the lives of aquatic animals.

articleTitle: Adaptive Weight-based Dollmaker Optimization Algorithm for Energy Efficient clustering and routing in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Wireless sensor network (WSN) is a self-optimizing network composed of many small sensor nodes used to monitor a wide range of applications. The main objective of this clustering and routing is to obtain high network lifetime with less energy usage. Therefore, this research proposes an Adaptive Weight-based Dollmaker Optimization Algorithm (AWDOA) for Cluster Head (CH) and route selection in Internet of Things (IoT) based Wireless Sensor Network (WSN). The AWDOA enhances both efficiency and precision of CH and route thereby enhancing overall performance. It enables to dynamically adopts exploration and exploitation by enabling search space in complex solutions. Its flexibility enhances convergence speed and avoid local optima issues thereby ensuring optimal network lifetime. The residual energy, node degree, communication cost and distance are measured as fitness function for AWDOA. The Energy Consumption (EC), Network Lifetime (NL) and Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) metrics are considered to show effectiveness of AWDOA. The AWDOA achieves 31.63mJ of EC, 6850rounds of NL and 99.86% of PDR for 200 no. of nodes.

articleTitle: Adaptive Energy Management Strategies for Hybrid Energy Systems Using Multi Object Grey Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In the current scenario, sunshine and wind are renewable energy sources, which are available across the planet, and they are sustainable alternatives because of self-reproduction. Even though, all isolated resources are established manually and simultaneously in a globular way. If networks perform inconsistently and resources produce less power than required. To overcome this issue, the Multi Object Grey Wolf Optimization (MOGWO) is proposed to manage renewable resources for grid systems. The proposed MOGWO optimizes the parameters and manage the renewable energy sources including Photo-Voltaic (PV), wind and battery with a duty cycle. The peak demands of resources are effectively managed by using proposed MOGWO and over voltage is encountered by the duty cycle. The energy is utilized in a consistent way by switching DC-converters. In the first zero interval, the proposed MOGWO established powers of PV 80.12W, wind 67.45W and battery 29.45W and in final interval, the proposed MOGWO provided powers of PV 86.45W, wind 71.39W and battery 29.99W.

articleTitle: Time Series Anomaly Detection and Prediction Model Integrating Multimodal Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Time series anomaly detection in multimodal data is crucial for data analysis and mining. However, existing multimodal detection methods mainly focus on single-mode data and fail to effectively explore the distribution characteristics of multimodal data in multimodal space, the adaptive fusion of multimodal features, and the extraction of spatiotemporal dependencies between multimodal features. To address the above issues, this project aims to study a multi-modal feature adaptive fusion method based on one-dimensional convolutional networks, in order to solve the problem of adaptive fusion between multi-source temporal and multi-modal features. For the fused multimodal features, a spatiotemporal attention model can be established that includes both temporal and spatial attention dimensions, and its spatiotemporal correlation can be extracted to obtain spatiotemporal attention vectors, thereby obtaining prediction results. Through testing on three public datasets, the results show that the time series anomaly detection method based on multimodal feature fusion has significant advantages.

articleTitle: An Optimal Scheduling of Energy Storage Units in Renewable Energy Systems Using Strength-Pareto Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Dual-stage optimization scheduling model by hybrid energy storage for grid-connected renewable energy systems, is proposed in this paper which focuses on both intra-day and day-ahead phases. In day-ahead phase, model improves economic efficiency by considering of price values at its peak value difference. In intra-day phase, its motive is to decrease renewable energy usage and it’s related with the day-ahead schedules using accurate, short-term predictions. Strength-pareto evolutionary algorithm 2 (SPEA2) algorithm for optimization is for multiple objective optimizations, achieving optimal and balanced solutions across multiple objectives. This SPEA2 optimization algorithm efficient handles and it enables system to cost-effectively and firmly operate and optimizing scheduling of grid-connected systems by addressing both the aspects of economic and operational. Overall, the model improves economic efficiency, reduces 6.3% the usage of renewable energy, and improves the sustainability power grid through effective integration and utilization of renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Multi-Direction Strategy with Honey Badger Algorithm and Convolutional Neural Network for Industrial Robot Visual Servo Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The Industrial robot visual servo image processing requires highly autonomous and intelligence robotic manipulators, with goal of performing manipulation tasks independently without human interventions. However, limit efficiency for large scale, sensitive to noise in input data which affect classification accuracy. This paper, proposed Multi-Direction Strategy with Honey Badger Algorithm (MHBA) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for classification is effectively explore the hyper parameter space of CNN technique is help achieve classification accuracy. The MHBA ability to adapt and explore multiple directions in the parameter space makes CNN maximum efficient to variation in input data. The MHBA model is applied to large scale CNN model is efficiently narrowing down the search space and balances exploration and exploitation allowing for search space. The Pre-processing using linear transformation such as translation or rotation help in adjusting the image dimension while maintaining the essential content. The proposed MHBA-CNN technique for industrial robot is achieving better outcomes such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 2.03, Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE) of 3.45, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 2.45 on raw dataset. The existing technique such as Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) are evaluated of proposed method.

Author Keywords: multi-direction strategy with honey badger and recurrent neural network

articleTitle: Chinese Speaking Emotion Recognition and Emotion Synthesis based on BERT Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: People pay more and more attention to emotion recognition and synthesis in spoken Chinese. Aiming at emotional recognition of spoken Chinese, this paper uses BERT model to extract emotional features from text data, and fine-tunes the model to adapt to emotional goals. Through comparative experiments, the performance of BERT model is evaluated from three aspects: rated naturalness, stability of emotion recognition and macro average accuracy. This paper also compares the performance of BERT model with Word2Vec model and Lite BERT (ALBERT) model. Experiments show that the naturalness of Bert model is 80. In the aspect of stable emotion recognition, the performance of BERT model has been significantly improved, with less fluctuation in accuracy and the best robustness.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of English Learning Resource Recommendation System based on Text Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In the current era of information technology, students are exposed to more diverse learning materials in the online environment, which makes the selection of English learning resources a challenge. This study aims to develop a personalized English learning resource recommendation system based on CNN-LSTM model through deep learning techniques, especially text mining. We collected a large amount of English learning resource data from the web and performed preprocessing and feature engineering to train the CNN-LSTM model. The experimental results show that the system performs well with an AUC value of 0.92 and high accuracy, and the user satisfaction survey also shows high user acceptance. In the future, we plan to extend this system to other language learning domains to verify its wide applicability.

articleTitle: Construction of a Rehabilitation Intelligent Monitoring System based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the aging population and the occurrence and development of a series of chronic diseases in various countries around the world, in addition to conventional diagnosis and treatment, rehabilitation medicine also plays a crucial role in the diagnosis and treatment process, and is increasingly known and recognized by people. However, traditional rehabilitation treatment has a series of drawbacks such as lack of data, poor continuity of rehabilitation, and low enthusiasm of patients in the process of rehabilitation treatment. The operation of the intelligent rehabilitation system can precisely overcome the related shortcomings and deficiencies. After completing the hardware and software design of the system, it provides a software and hardware foundation for the system to achieve physiological parameter monitoring. Establishing a motor function examination and evaluation file for brain patients during the treatment process, providing objective and accurate real-time data for doctors, saving treatment time, improving treatment efficiency, further reducing the burden on families and society, and promoting the further development and improvement of clinical rehabilitation medicine.

articleTitle: E-commerce Platform Product Recommendation Algorithm Combining SVM Algorithm and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The recommendation system of e-commerce platform is an important link to improve user experience and promote orders. This paper first improves the recommendation algorithm, then designs data preprocessing and feature engineering for machine learning algorithm, and demonstrates the model construction process. Finally, through carefully designed data stream processing, feature selection and model training, the recommendation system can truly understand and predict complex user behavior patterns. It can be seen from the experimental data that the recommended coverage rate of the system is stable at 81.2%-98.4%, which proves that the system has a wide range of products for users to recommend. At the same time, after adopting the attention mechanism, the accuracy of the system is rapidly improved, and the accuracy of the recommendation system will reach 99.5%. To sum up, this paper further optimizes the parameter structure and algorithm of the model, and optimizes the system security. The high load performance is due to its limited space.

articleTitle: Traffic Congestion Prediction in Smart Cities using Multilevel-Gated Recurrent Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Traffic Congestion (TC) is a main issue in smart cities because of increase in urbanization, as a result in financial losses. However, existing prediction algorithms failed to predict TC effectively due to dynamic changes of road network. To overcome this problem, a Multilevel-Gated Recurrent Unit (MGRU) is proposed for accurate prediction of traffic flow and congestion avoidance in smart cities. The main advantage of proposed M-GRU model is that it reduces errors while prediction by multilevel layers in softmax that passes information to adapt dynamic changes of road network. The data acquired based on weather conditions, number of vehicles improved the prediction process which utilized a few factors for prediction than previous prediction methods. Then the traffic density is estimated to predict TC on the road. Finally, the TC is predicted accurately by the proposed M-GRU model. The experimental results of the proposed method attained better results accuracy of 0.887, Mean Absolute Error (MAE) is 82.34 which is less than compared to existing method such as Convolutional Neural Network and Bidirectional-Long Short-Term Memory (Conv-Bi-LSTM).

Author Keywords: smart cities and traffic congestion prediction

articleTitle: Speech Signal Segmentation using Zero Crossing Rate and Short-Time Energy for Speech Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The selection of unvoiced and voiced signals is typically made through the analysis of speech by extracting the desired set of information from the given speech signal. The different approaches for distinguishing between the segments of unvoiced and voiced portions speech signal are presented in this study. These techniques rely on the autocorrelation of various speech signal segments as well as the zero crossing rat (ZCR) and short-time energy (STE) calculations. Theoretical research has shown that spoken segments have high energy and magnitude whereas voiced signals have low ZCR rate. In this work, the autocorrelation function is used to demonstrate how unvoiced signals lose their periodicity while the voiced portion of speech maintains its periodicity after applying the autocorrelation function. The simulation results depicted in this paper validates the theoretical research.

articleTitle: Research on Small Object Detection Algorithm in Complex Construction Environment Based on Deformable Convolutional Operator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Industrial safety and construction site management have always been a major concern. The correct wearing of helmet is one of the key measures to reduce industrial safety accidents. This study proposes a method for recognising the correct wearing of safety helmets based on the improved YOLOv5. By analysing the actual detection of the correct wearing of safety helmets by construction workers at actual site locations, the YOLOv5 model is optimised by improving the YOLOv5 model by modifying the convolution operator module and the loss function module in order to further improve the model's detection accuracy for small items. The goal of this study is to achieve automatic monitoring and ensure that staff wear helmets correctly on construction sites and in industrial environments.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Web-based Education Management System using Split and Kernel based Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: A web based education management system is established to develop education system by enhancing quality of education and teaching model. However, the existing resource allocation model and teaching in web-based education system has limitations such as ineffective teaching due to inappropriate resource allocation affect the education system. To overcome this problem, a Split and Kernel based Residual Network (SK-ResNet) is proposed to improve quality of education by allocating resources effectively and enhance teaching model in the web based education system. The split technique in ResNet model, divide the tasks and distributed across multiple servers or devices. By splitting and kernel optimizing the tasks, the load on any single system allows the model for faster content processing and delivery. At first, the data are acquired and fed into functional structure of education system, and finally analyzed and integrated into cloud computing based on SK-ResNet model. The experimental results of the proposed method achieved accuracy of 87.29% which is greater when compared to existing method such as Deep Neural Network (DNN) and Hybrid Deep Learning (HDL) model.

Author Keywords: split and kernel based residual network

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Modular Neural Networks based on Cluster Analysis: Applied to Complex Data Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The recognition of complex data patterns in a typical application is always a difficult topic. From the perspective of designing modular RNN and optimization based on cluster analysis to improve accuracy and stability in complex data pattern recognition, many researchers have taken actions in this direction. This article proposes a module RNN based on the method of cluster analysis in order to classify and identify patterns in complex data. Three methods, namely RNN, CNN, and LSTM, are employed in the experiment to evaluate three aspects of algorithm accuracy, recognition time, and algorithm stability. Complex data pattern recognition has brought significant improvement in the modular RNN based on cluster analysis. Secondly, from the perspective of accuracy, this method has good application value: experimental accuracy ranges from 92% to 98%. Lastly, the algorithm stability ranges from 94% to 100%, realiably showing that the overall performance of the proposed method is consistently strong on a range of different tasks and datasets.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Parallel Prefix Adders
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The speed, size, and power consumption of adders are always trade-offs that affect the system’s overall performance. One of the performance issues is carry propagation, which restricts the speed of the addition process. When it comes to latency and coverage area, Parallel Prefix Adders (PPAs) are the greatest adders on the market right now. The implementation and comparison of four widely used parallel adders—the Brent-Kung Adder, the Kogge-Stone Adder, the J Sklansky Adder, and the Ladner-Fischer Adder—are covered in this paper, The adders obtained delays are 5.910 ns, 4.580 ns, 4.148 ns, and 4.520 ns, respectively, and their corresponding power outputs are 15.196uW, 20.532uW, 17.864uW, and 11.240uW. In this research, the adders power consumption and delays have been compared. It’s discovered that no single adder can provide benefits for Power and Delay performance characteristics. Different adders are preferred for specific aspects; therefore, they are chosen based on design requirements.

articleTitle: Designing and Analyzing a Voltage- Controlled Oscillator for the Front End
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: These devices are designed to intended to generate an output signal whose frequency fluctuates with the voltage amplitude of an input signal. The basic principle behind voltage-controlled oscillator is that an oscillator circuit's resonant frequency is controlled by a voltage in the fundamental idea of a voltage control oscillator (VCO). The oscillator's output frequency can be changed by adjusting the control voltage. In this paper we implement the circuit design of the Voltage Controlled Oscillator and analyze the different characteristics of voltage-controlled oscillator. Here we used Complementary MOS technique with GPDK90nm technology. The output sinusoidal waveform with frequency of 935Mhz is obtained. VCO are mostly used in the communication system especially wireless communication. Hence, they have huge application in digital communication. The stimulation of the circuit is done by using cadence tool.

articleTitle: Music Genre Classification based on Bidirectional-Long Short Term Memory Combined Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Music is known to be time series data, where the increase in the data size pose a significant challenge to build a robust music genre classification system. The robust system requires large amount of labelled music data and necessitates the requirement of capturing effective data features for enhanced classification of music genre. The proposed research focused on developing a Deep Learning (DL) framework for classification with four steps. Initially, the music labelled data is collected from the GTZAN and ballroom dataset. The collected data is pre-processed using normalization for equalizing the volume of all samples from the database to achieve a constant level. The pre-processed data undergoes feature extraction to extract Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs). These features obtain characteristics of an audio signal that describes the short-term power spectrum on the mel scale of the audiobook signals. The extracted features are successfully classified using Bidirectional-Long Short Term Memory combined Convolutional Neural Network (Bi-LSTM-CNN). The proposed Bi-LSTM-CNN achieved 98.79% accuracy, 97.84% precision, and 97.05% f1-score which surpassed existing DL approach such as Masked Predictive Encoder- Recurrent Neural Network (MPE-RNN) and VGG16- Bi-LSTM.

articleTitle: Enhancing Glaucoma Detection through Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Glaucoma is a condition characterized by the gradual loss of retinal cells in the optic nerve, leading to irreversible vision impairment due to optic neuropathy. This disease often progresses silently, without early symptoms, making its detection challenging until significant vision loss has already occurred. To address this critical issue, deep learning (DL) models have emerged as powerful tools for precise glaucoma detection. Our proposed architecture harnesses deep learning, specifically utilizing a convolutional neural network (CNN), to significantly enhance the accuracy of glaucoma detection. CNNs are particularly adept at extracting intricate patterns that distinguish between glaucomatous and healthy conditions, leveraging their hierarchical feature extraction capabilities in image analysis. Central to our approach is the evaluation of the optic cup-to-disc ratio, a crucial metric in the diagnosis of glaucoma. Moreover, we integrate an image data generator to augment our dataset, thereby enriching and refining the diagnostic process. This augmentation enhances the model's ability to generalize and perform effectively across diverse datasets. Our model demonstrates outstanding performance, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 98%, surpassing many existing algorithms in terms of both efficacy and reliability.

articleTitle: College Graduates’ Employment Recommendation using Hybrid Deep Learning based Convolutional Deep Semantic Structure Modelling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Employment recommendation for college graduates is highly crucial in the current job market to identify the correct career prospects. The proposed research aims at improving the functionality of job recommendation systems using Convolutional Deep Semantic Structure Model with Hybrid Deep Learning (CDSSM-HDL) model. The input is considered as the data from LinkedIn for in depth identification and processing of the semantic structures such as job postings and users’ profiles. The Hybrid Deep Learning (HDL) approach improves this feature extraction process by having multiple layers of neural networks from Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) that learn higher-level features step by step.
