This resulted in providing better and more targeted recommendations to a particular job seeker or a particular job opening by reducing the sparsity and the cold-start issues inherent in recommendation systems. The experimental results showed that the proposed CDSSM-HDL model achieved better recommendation accuracy of 98.94%, recommended recall rate of 94.25%, and Mean Square Error (MSE) of 0.63, when compared to the existing methods such as Puppeteer and Representational State Transfer (REST) Application Programming Interface (API) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN).

articleTitle: Optimization of Deep Learning Models for Non-stationary Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This paper studies the optimization and application of deep learning models for non-stationary time series data, especially in the field of financial time series prediction. In view of the limitations of traditional models in processing non-stationary data, this paper designs a prediction framework based on the Transformer model. Through the series stabilization and destabilization attention modules, the model’s prediction ability for non-stationary time series data is effectively improved. Experimental results show that the designed model can achieve a price point prediction accuracy of up to 94.6%, and is superior to traditional methods in terms of computational efficiency, generalization ability and data processing capabilities. This study not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of financial time series prediction, but also provides new ideas and methods for deep learning modeling of non-stationary time series data.

articleTitle: Multiband Planar Sierpinski Bow-Tie Antenna Design for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This paper presents a multiband planar Sierpinski bow-tie antenna designed for Internet-of-Things (IoT) applications. The antenna aims to fulfill the requirements of compactness, multiband operation, and suitability for IoT environments. Leveraging Sierpinski geometry principles, a compact single-substrate planar antenna architecture is proposed with five iterations. These elements cover essential frequency bands for IoT communication, including long-term evolution bands above 1 GHz, radio frequency identification bands centered around 4 and 8 GHz. Simulation results demonstrates satisfactory radiation characteristics, with gains of approximately 6 dBi for the 1 – 2 GHz band, 10 dBi for the 4 GHz band, 9 dBi for the 8 GHz band. The validation of the design is conducted through numerical analysis, assessing parameters such as return loss, 3D radiation patterns, and gains.

articleTitle: Construction of a Neural Machine Translation Model based on Cloud LM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In the context of global integration, the demand for machine translation is also increasing. Traditional machine translation methods are subject to certain limitations in accuracy and fluency. In response to this issue, this article intends to use the Cloud Language Model (Cloud LM), based on deep learning, to study the NMT (Neural Machine Translation) modeling method based on deep learning, and conduct a large number of experiments. In the robustness test, when there is no noise, the noise intensity is 0%, the BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy) score is 27.5, and the translation accuracy is 90%; When subjected to random noise, the noise intensity is 5%, the BLEU score is 26.2, and the translation accuracy is 88%. The experimental results show that the quality of multilingual translations based on Cloud LM is significantly better than traditional NMT models. The research results of this article can play a certain promoting role in the development of machine translation theory, and also have reference significance for other natural language processing problems.

articleTitle: Transformer vs. LSTM: Evaluating Machine Translation models for Sanskrit to English and Sanskrit to Hindi Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has emerged as a dominant technique offering fluent and natural translations across various language pairs, but it demands substantial computational resources and large datasets, posing challenges with rare words or phrases. This research leverages the Bhagavad Gita dataset, consisting of 700 parallel Sanskrit-English and Sanskrit-Hindi sentences and a larger dataset of 13,000 English-Sanskrit parallel sentences from the Srimad Bhagavatam. The evaluation metrics for translation quality include BLEU and METEOR scores. The Transformer model consistently outperformed the LSTM model in translating Sanskrit to English and Sanskrit to Hindi, demonstrating higher BLEU and METEOR scores. Notably, Sanskrit-Hindi translations achieved better scores than Sanskrit-English translations, indicating that the Transformer model is more effective for languages with similar syntactic structures. The LSTM model exhibited over-fitting with smaller datasets but performed adequately with larger datasets. Training curves indicated optimal performance of Transformer models within 20 epochs, whereas LSTM models required more extensive training.

articleTitle: Implementation of optimized technique for enhancing EEG signal Quality by improving Signal to Noise Ratio
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Optimized technique for enhancing EEG signal quality by improving the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). EEG signals are inherently noisy due to various factors, such as the presence of biological and environmental artifacts, and low amplitude of brain signals. The proposed technique involves the application of advanced signal processing algorithms, including wavelet denoising, independent component analysis (ICA), and adaptive filtering. These algorithms are applied sequentially to reduce noise and improve the SNR of EEG signals. The proposed technique was tested on real EEG data and showed a significant improvement in the quality of the EEG signals. The results demonstrate that the optimized technique can effectively enhance the SNR of EEG signals and improve their quality, which could have important implications in clinical and research applications of EEG.

articleTitle: Creative Product Design of Intangible Cultural Heritage using Deep Convolutional Neural Network Combined Style Transfer Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The preservation of Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) with the traditional design principles in the modern era is a concerning issue since it is a part of economic growth. The aim of this research is to develop artistic design of ICH products using Style Transfer Algorithm (STA). The proposed method of using an STA with a Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) adapts cultural elements into creative products while making sure that the design is up-to-date by using cultural elements in the design. This leads to the innovative thought whereby the client and his team have to analyze cultural resources, understand user needs, and suggest a style that should be applied to come up with a new product that will embody the culture of the heritage. A VGG-19 network is implemented to extract the style where convolution operation is useful for feature learning. The results showed better output results in functional utility 4.84, user satisfaction in terms of cultural connotation with 4.28, appearance of 3.97, and practicality of 4.06 when compared to the existing methods Kano and Quality Function Development (Kano-QFD) and Artificial Intelligence based ICH (AI-ICH).

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Battel Royale Optimizer Based Optimal Control of Industrial Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Many industrial robots are given through manufacturer with the controller which can’t changed through user. This kind of arrangement is generally determined to nearest control structure, that is not probable for processing the arbitrary control laws. To implement the novel algorithms, that is on contrary essential for assigning the open control structure, that allowed the program the control scheme. In this research, developed the Multi-Modal Battel Royale Optimizer (MM-BRO) algorithm for industrial robot optimization control. To find the appropriate neighbors the Coulomb’s law is used as the multi modal solution. That represents that solution with high beneficial location have higher chance of success. The MM-BRO algorithm enhances the performance of industrial robot optimization control. The developed MM-BRO algorithm reached 4.36 on $K_p^{\prime}$, 0.23 on $K_D^{\prime}$, 7.76 on K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>, 21.67 on K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</inf> and 0.06 on K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</inf> which is effective while compared to various optimization algorithms like Remora Optimization Algorithm (ROA) and Reptile Search Algorithm (RSA).

Author Keywords: remora optimization algorithm and reptile search algorithm

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Improved Pelican Optimization Algorithm for 3D Printed Footwear Products Design in Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The usage of three-dimensional (3D) image printing for footwear designs has expanded recently as a result of improvements in production processes and materials. Throughout the manufacturing process, enormous volumes of multi-modal data including text and graphics are generated, effectively personalizing goods remains a challenge. Thus, in this research, an artificial intelligence technique known as the Artificial Neural Network based Improved Pelican Optimization approach (ANN – IPOA) is designed to produce user-friendly material for 3D printing. First, data about shoes is collected using the Common Objects in Context (COCO) database. ANN which improves the 3D printing by mimicking pelican foraging behavior to optimize printing parameters. Then IPOA is utilized which offers effecient basis for optimizing selection. According to the results it illustrates that the proposed model has achieved better performance in terms of accuracy of 98.95% and print time of 1hr 12 min which is comparatively higher than existing models namely Mask Region Convolutional Neural Network (Mask RCNN) and Deep Neural Network (DNN).

Author Keywords: improved pelican optimization algorithm. three dimensional images

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Classification from Gene Expression Dataset Through Supervised Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Brain tumors are amongst the most prevalent diseases affecting the brain, can cause severe pain, and lead to various illnesses if not adequately treated. A notable factor contributing to the rising number of cancer cases worldwide is the lack of awareness and early intervention in tumor treatment. Early-stage diagnosis becomes crucial due to nonspecific symptoms, resulting in an improved prognosis. The main motive of this work is to categorize brain tumors using the gene expression dataset. The Gene expression dataset used in this study was a Gene Expression dataset which consists of 7130 features that include the information of 40 patients. Since the dataset contains many attributes, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Pearson correlation are used to choose features to minimize dimensionality for modeling. Machine learning approaches are utilized to categorize various types of brain tumor. The categorization of brain tumors involves the use of machine learning models such as Decision Tree Classifier (DT), Support Vector Machine Classifier (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), K-Nearest Neighbor Classifier (KNN), and Random Forest Classifier (RF). The concert of the machine learning approaches was assessed via classification performance metrics including accuracy, recall, precision, confusion matrix, and f1-score. Out of 40 patients, 10 patients were identified to have Medulloblastoma, 10 were found to have Glioma, 10 were found to have RhabdoidTu, 6 were found to have Primitive Neuro-Ectodermal Tumor (PNET) and 4 were found to be NORMAL. The experimental investigation concluded that the Logistic Regression approach outpaced other approaches such as RF, SVM, DT, and KNN.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Up-link Methods: O-FDMA vs. SC-FDMA in LTE Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing Access(OF-DMA) is susceptible to interference in dense deployment scenarios. When several users transmit data simultaneously over the same frequency band, interference between subcarriers can occur, degrading the quality of service. An OF-DMA has a high peak–to-average-power ratio (PAPR) and managing PAPR is challenging for high power applications. Single Carrier Frequency Division Multiple Access (SC-FDMA) is an emerging approach for achieving high data rates and mitigating inter-symbol interference (ISI). Though, the high PAPR in OFDMA leads to signal distortion due to nonlinearity at the receiver's end. Therefore, SC-FDMA technology is used to compensate this issue. The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) has implemented uplink communication in its next-generation cellular technology, known as Long-Term Evolution (LTE). The experiments are conducted for both SC-FDMA and OFDMA using PAPR and Bit Error Rate (BER) metrics. The results revealed that-the SC-FDMA has achieved the least PAPR and BER compared to OFDMA.

Author Keywords: single carrier frequency division multiple access (SC-FDMA)

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Automated Operation and Maintenance Technology in Wireless Network Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Smart grid promotes the evolution of modern power system to intelligence and automation, which makes the application of artificial intelligence and automatic operation and maintenance technology in wireless network power system of great significance. In this paper, the application performance of three cutting-edge time series prediction technologies, including long-term and short-term memory (LSTM) network, autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) and gated recursive unit (GRU), in wireless network power system is analyzed. Then the architecture design of wireless power system is put forward, and the coverage of wireless network and the security and reliability of data transmission are introduced. The experimental results show that the LSTM model has high time series prediction performance, the maximum failure rate is 1.3%, and the response time is 215-391 milliseconds, which reduces the system failure time and proves that the maximum failure time of the system is 157 minutes.

articleTitle: A Quantum Variational Classifier for Predictive Maintenance and Monitoring of Battery Health in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In order to ensure the dependability and durability of Electric Vehicles (EVs), there is an increasing requirement for improved maintenance systems. This research combines optical and quantum approaches to present a unique methodology for the predictive maintenance of EV components. High-resolution, real-time data on vital components including the battery, electric motor, and power electronics are captured by the Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) sensors. These sensors are useful because of their high sensitivity, ability to multiplex, and resilience to electromagnetic interference. A Quantum Variational Classifier (QVC) with quantum computing is proposed to manage massive datasets and improve prediction accuracy. The AI model is trained to anticipate possible failures and identify early indicators of component degradation, allowing for proactive maintenance and reducing downtime. The experimental results prove the efficacy of proposed method in providing accurate, appropriate predictions and improving the durability and performance of EV components. The proposed method achieved 0.0035 of MAE and 0.0097 of RMSE when compared with the existing methods.

articleTitle: Motion Measurement Data Analysis based on AI Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence identification technology shows great potential in processing sports data and improving the accuracy and efficiency of sports performance analysis. In this study, high-precision sensors and video acquisition systems are used to collect athletes' sports data in training and competition. Then, these data are preprocessed, including denoising, normalization and feature extraction. Next, the convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to classify and identify the athletes' movements. The research results show that, compared with traditional methods, the intersection and union (IoU) of AI identification technology based on CNN can reach 0.9, the minimum time efficiency can reach 27ms, and the F1 value can reach 0.91, which can more accurately identify athletes' action patterns, provide timely feedback and help optimize training plans.

articleTitle: Intelligent Prediction and Training Optimization of Sports using Enhanced Whale Optimized Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Enhancing the efficiency of the sports training should be provided since many of the athletic training methods used today are ineffective at considering the unique qualities of individual athletes. The proposed research aimed at developing intelligent prediction and optimization of basketball training using data from Federation Internationale de Basketball (FIBA) website and pre-processed using min max normalization. The Capsule Network (CapsNet) of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used to extract features and the classified using Attention mechanism combined Convolutional Random Forest (AttConv-RF). CapsNet makes it possible to improve the model's capabilities due to the updated loss function. The ConvRF unit recognizes spatial and temporal relationships of the training data, decreasing overfitting issues primarily while training data are limited. The performance prediction is carried out using Enhanced Whale Optimization Algorithm based Artificial Neural Network (EWOA-ANN). The results showed that proposed EWOA-ANN approach achieved better performance prediction at accuracy with 99.56%, precision of 97.42%, and recall 96.36% when compared with the existing methods Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) and eXtreme Gradient Boost (XGB).

articleTitle: Levy Flight Strategy with Tasmanian Devil’s Optimization for Financial Market Forecasting and Investment Decision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Decision-making in the stock market is complex, demanding substantial trading experience and expertise. However, this process does not eliminate boundaries but rather highlights their fluid and interconnected nature. This paper, Levy Flight Strategy with Tasmanian Devil’s Optimization (LTDO) for feature selection and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for classification for highly efficiently at detecting patterns in data, which is crucial in financial forecasting as patterns in historical data. Initially stage is pre-processing is considering the min max is performed to handle less sensitive and non-uniform values. The LTDO is efficiently in feature selection, which helps to reduce the dimensionality of input data, ensuring that only the most relevant feature is used for forecasting. The CNN are particularly useful for analysing historical financial data and capability of feature further enhances the model predictive performance. The proposed ensemble model technique for ship motion detection is achieving better outcomes such as high accuracy of 92.81%, precision of 90.13%, recall of 90.59% and F1 score of 90.95% respectively. The existing technique such Random Forest (RF) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) are evaluated of proposed method.

Author Keywords: levy flight strategy with tasmanian devil’s optimization
long short-term memory and random forest

articleTitle: Optimizing Virtual Machines in Cloud Resources using Gaussian Median based Tunicate Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The growing demand for cloud services, coupled with the need for immediate provisioning of virtual machines (VMs) with varying resource sizes and types, creates an imbalance in cloud data centres. Although current cloud-based frameworks offer VM services, they also face challenges such as high energy consumption, increased computational costs, and other inefficiencies. This research aims to propose the Gaussian Medium based Tunicate Swarm Optimization (GM-TSA) approach for effective task scheduling in cloud environments. A combination of GM improves the convergence rate, permitting the approach to identify optimal solutions more rapidly. This research considers the three main multi-objective functions makespan, execution time and Resource Utilization (RU) to efficiently schedule the loss. The experimental results show that the proposed GM-TSA approach achieves the minimum makespan, minimum execution time and maximum RU of 58.8s, 720s and 92.0% on the 200 tasks, respectively, as opposed to the existing method, Particle Swarm Optimization with Grey Wolf Optimization (PSGWO) approach.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Piezoelectric Resonator for Sensor Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This research focuses on the design and simulation of piezoelectric resonator based on aluminum nitride (AlN) material intended for sensor application. The core component of this resonator is constructed using AlN material. This paper meticulously outlines the design parameters of the aluminum nitride piezoelectric resonator, encompassing material properties, size and shape, which were systematically optimized through finite element simulation software. The structural design was optimised, and a simulation was conducted using COMSOL Multiphysics tool to assess the resulting performance for the pressure sensor application. Using FEM modelling, the parameters like resonant frequency, admittance (Y11) and the reflection coefficient (S11) were studied. The resonant frequency achieved for the designed resonator is determined to be 2.188 GHz. The admittance (Y11) and the reflection coefficient (S11) is 143.3 dB and 34.62 dB respectively. As a part of the work, the comparative analysis of the resonator performance parameters with different materials like Zinc Sulfide (ZnS), Cadmium Sulfide (CdS), and zinc oxide (ZnO) were assigned as piezoelectric material and compared the results with AlN based resonator. However, it was found that AlN based resonator results are more effective than others. This comprehensive investigation provides crucial insights into the optimization of piezoelectric resonators tailored for pressure sensor applications. The results of this research also possess the capacity to substantially improve the precision and sensitivity of future pressure sensors. This discoveries offers a substantial contribution to the advancement of pressure sensing as a discipline, offering prospects for the creation of pressure sensors with exceptional performance. Predictably, this study will establish a fundamental basis for subsequent investigations in this field.

articleTitle: Digital Labor Education System using Neural Autoregressive Distribution Estimator based Visual Geometry Group-16 Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Recently, there is a lack of research in developing Labor Education System (LES) using digital platform and which assist to guide labors. However, the ineffective teaching model lead to decrease the effectiveness of labor education using digital platform. To overcome this, a Neural Autoregressive Distribution Estimator based Visual Geometry Group-16 (NADE-VGG-16) network to analyze effectiveness of teaching model in labor education system. In the context of labor education, the NADE method helps the VGG-16 network model to capture interdependencies between various factors such as teaching techniques, student engagement, practical outcomes to provide a more accurate evaluation results of the teaching model. Initially, the data related to education are acquired from four different datasets with various classes and fed to preprocessing phase to enhance the data quality by word embedding method. Then, the preprocessed data is passed to proposed teaching evaluation model to analyze the efficiency of teaching model. The experimental results of proposed method achieved mean and standard deviation of 0.15 and 0.22 when compared to the existing evaluation method such as Collaborative Filter and Content based filter (CFC).

articleTitle: Test Case Optimization Through Ant Colony Optimization Enabled Boosted Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The avalanche of data creates complex operational issues in real world scenarios. In terms of making the test procedures simple and effective test case optimization techniques are applied. To achieve better test case performance, the proposed system focused on creating a model centric method that comparatively overheads the test case optimization works. The presented system considers the comparative evaluation of test case optimization of MIS dataset. The methods such as Linear regression (LR), Customized Random Forest regression (RFR), the robust Gradient boost regression (GBR), dynamically working Support vector machine (SVM) and proposed Ant colony optimized Boosted regression model (ACO-BRM). The proposed approach exposed to the benefit of nature inspired optimization model named ant colony and optimized the test cases with boosted regression model and achieved the minimum of mean absolute error of 0.34 comparatively with existing state of art approaches. The priority score is enhanced after the optimization process.

articleTitle: Performance Juxtapose of Plant Leaf Disease Detection using Adaptive Deep Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (ADCRNN) in MATLAB Versus Python
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Leaf diseases can cause several detriments in crops' overall yield and fertility. While analyzing the various diseases that affect plants is imperative, identifying the diseases using algorithmic techniques that render optimal performance is crucial. In agriculture, detecting multiple diseases in plants is difficult. However, the provision to automate disease identification through machine learning approaches through the various phases of preprocessing and segmentation is implemented in this study. This indagation delineates the leaf disease identification using the proposed hybrid algorithmic Adaptive Deep Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (ADCRNN) in bifurcated platforms such as MATLAB and Python. The Radial basis function is incorporated to optimize the throughput in MATLAB before observing the juxtaposed results in both platforms. The purpose of utilizing ADCRNN is to effectively combine the advantages and parallelly overcome the challenges of Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN), RNN, and adaptive techniques that unsheathe the pivotal features from the provided input. The ADCRNN simulation is carried out in MATLAB and Python, and the results are successfully obtained. In addition, after optimization, the proposed ADCRNN technique’s accuracy increased to 94.5% in performance evaluation in MATLAB.

Author Keywords: adaptive deep convolutional recurrent neural network (ADCRNN)

articleTitle: Self-attention Convolutional Long Short Term Memory for Intelligent Detection System in English Translation Errors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The English translation error detection and learning, intelligent system software is required to transform traditional English teaching as well as learning. However, English language processing faces challenges in finding and correction errors, especially with small data due to the risk of overfitting. In this paper, Self-attention Conv Long Short-Term Memory (SA-ConvLSTM) network, which enables the model to focus on relationships between distant words. This capability is crucial for detecting errors in complex translations, where issues with word order. The Conv LSTM capture local feature like phase structures and LSTM maintains sequence context allowing it to learn how errors develop over time in the sentence. The system ability to capture both local and global sentence learn efficiently for detecting English translation of errors improving its effectiveness to evaluated using BEA-2019 dataset. The proposed SA-ConvLSTM network achieve better accuracy of 91.02%, recall of 89.59%, precision of 91.06%, and F1-score of 89.12% on BEA-2019 dataset. The existing method such as Long Short Term Memory -Conditional Random Field model (LSTM-CRF) and Detection-Correction Structure named (DeCoGLM) based on General Language Model (GLM) are evaluated proposed method.

Author Keywords: general language model and self-attention conv long short term memory

articleTitle: A Distributed Pricing Mechanism and Optimal Schedulingin Smart Grid using Improved Grey Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In recent days, energy is most important resource new techniques and methods which introduced to fulfill energy demand for price-based demand response (DR). The preface to this study has shown that load management strategies implemented based on Costlier scheduling for low or consistent energy users results from price-based demand response strategies. Suggested work has taken into account and broadened the same concept to include numerous EV charging regions and corresponding loads from an analytical and implementation point of view. This research provides an innovative approach called Improved Grey Wolf Optimization (IGWO) that uses the distinct energy consumption patterns of EVs in each location to calculate EV charging costs. Dynamic price signal that is non-discriminatory is sent to all EV regions and stations. First, a brand-new mathematical model based on market dynamics and real-time load demand is provided to determine charging prices. The global optimum solution produced by the optimization algorithm successfully converges, confirming the efficacy of the suggested mechanism. Lastly, analysis and simulation outcomes are performed to demonstrate the accomplishments of our suggested task in standings of reasonable cost high user satisfaction distribution. IGWO demonstrated usefulness's revenue is modest by either mechanism or cost saving is 0.69-6.89%.

articleTitle: A Hand Gesture Recognition Based on SqueezeNet and Octave Convolution Feature Extraction Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In recent days, sign recognition plays an important role in overcoming the communication barriers between hearing-impaired community and the normal society where sign language is essential. This paper proposes an efficient feature extraction and feature mapping technique by employing SqueezeNet fusion Octave Convolution method (SqueezeNet fusion OctConv). Initially, the input image data is preprocessed to transform the data to a common scale and avoid imbalance of model. The SqueezeNet model with fire module is employed for efficient parameter reduction and significant feature extraction. The Octave Convolutional (OctConv) technique is applied to refine the extracted features that optimizes the feature utilization, handles spatial components and reduces redundancy which enhances the feature representation. The integration of fully connected layers with spatial attention mechanism enables the model to learn complex relationships and assign weights based on relevance ensuring precise classification. The proposed method is evaluated on NUS-II dataset and achieved high accuracy of 99.25% which surpassed the existing sign recognition models such as Intensive Feature Extrication Deep Network, Densely Connected Res2Net.

articleTitle: Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman based Privacy-Preserving Deduplication for Big Data in Cloud Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Data deduplication is crucial for cloud computing, particularly in managing the expansive growth of outsourced mobile data. Some existing approaches are vulnerable to brute-force attacks and single-point attacks, posing significant security risks. Furthermore, it causes substantial complexity on the resource-constrained edge nodes and the lack of support for cross-domain deduplication. To overcome this problem, this research aims to propose an effective and secure big data deduplication approach in cloud computing. This research proposes the novel combined encryption algorithm of the Elliptic Curve with Diffie Hellman (ECDH) for data privacy preservation and deduplication. The effectiveness and the security of the ECDH approach permit it to manage the enhanced data volumes in the multi-domain framework without significant performance degradation. The experimental results show that the proposed ECDH approach attains the effective communication overhead of data upload and data retrieval of 5.98Kb and 1.39Kb on the data size of 2Kb respectively as compared to the existing methods EC and DH.

articleTitle: Efficiency Enhancement of Electric Vehicles with ANFIS-Based Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The burgeoning expansion of electric vehicles (EVs) has accentuated the imperative for sophisticated energy management systems, aimed at augmenting their efficacy while mitigating range constraints. This abstract delineates a proposition for an Energy Management System, underpinned by a Neuro-Fuzzy System controller, meticulously devised to augment the efficiency of electrical energy utilization within EVs. The paramount aim is to ameliorate overall energy proficiency, elongate driving range, and fortify the reliability of EVs. The contemplated system exploits the adaptive and self-learning characteristics of ANFIS to dynamically regulate power distribution among various components within the electric vehicle, encompassing, though not restricted to, the battery, fuel cell, and motor. The incorporation of ANFIS into the energy management system facilitates the model's adaptation to diverse driving patterns. Simulation results and comparative analyses confirm the effectiveness of the proposed ANFIS controller-based energy management system in improving the overall performance of electric vehicles. Through this innovative approach, EVs can achieve greater efficiency, longer driving ranges, and enhanced reliability, driving forward the adoption of sustainable transportation solutions.

articleTitle: Automated Forest Types Classification using Ensemble Machine Learning in Hyperspectral Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The forest is a major factor in the changes in climatic conditions. As the population is increasing the needs of humans are also growing, where numerous of forest areas are destroyed for civilization. The Ensemble Machine Learning (ML) classifier is proposed for forest type classification in hyperspectral satellite images. The ensemble ML classifiers such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Random Forest (RF) leads to enhance the robustness and accuracy. The SVM provides better generalization, KNN captures local patterns and RF includes robustness to overfitting thereby enhancing classification performance. The Local Ternary Pattern (LTP) is used for feature extraction which enhances the robustness to noise and it captures texture data through encoding three distinct states that assist to classify forest types. The median filter is used as preprocessing which effectively removes noise without reducing image sharpness. The ensemble ML got better performance of 98.4% recall, 98.7% precision, 99.2% accuracy and 98.6% f1-score for Sentinel-2 dataset compared to VGG19 and ResNet50.

articleTitle: Martial Arts Movement and Posture Recognition using Quantum Multi-Verse Optimization based Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In recent years, the exceptional growth of sports and globalization of martial arts events has resulted in a constant improvement in competition regulations. However, it is critical to detect and correct technical errors in martial art. As a result, a visual image-based technique is necessary to consistently and effectively detect martial arts movements. As a result, this paper proposed utilizing Quantum Multi-Verse Optimization-based Long Short-Term Memory (QMVO-LSTM) to distinguish human martial arts motions and postures using image recognition. Then the edge parts of human body curve are detected after the bulk of the background noise has been removed using the morphological gradient approach. Next, dynamic temporal warping is performed to compare the classifier and joint change sequences across diverse martial arts activities. Finally, the suggested QMVO-LSTM is used to image recognition in order to evaluate and categorize human martial arts abilities. According to the results, it illustrates that the suggested QMVO-LSTM model has achieved better in terms Accuracy of 99.88% and recall of 99.86% which is comparatively higher when compared to existing models such as Attention enhanced Spatial Temporal Graph Convolutional LSTM (ASTGC-LSTM), Two-Dimensional Principal Component Analysis (2D-PCA) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of True Random Number Test Pattern Generator for Enhanced BIST Performance in Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Background: Built-In Self-Test (BIST) modules are crucial for integrated circuits (IC), providing automatic error detection and correction for memory and stuck-at faults. Traditional approaches, particularly Linear Feedback Shift Registers (LFSRs), have been limited by insufficient randomization and inefficient hardware resource utilization. Methods: This study addresses these limitations by developing True Random Number Test Pattern Generator (TRN-TPG) frameworks. The approach involves replacing conventional ring oscillators with Digital Clock Managers (DCMs) to enhance the tunability of phase and frequency of random numbers. Beat frequency detection is achieved using D-flip flops (D-FFs), post-processing units, and counters. Results: Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed TRN-TPG framework significantly improves performance compared to traditional methods. Specifically, it offers less utilization in terms of 16 number of look-up-tables, 0.54ns of latency, and 32.83mw of power consumption. Concluding Remarks: The findings suggest that the TRN-TPG framework is a superior alternative to conventional BIST designs, providing better randomization with lower hardware resource utilization.

articleTitle: Intelligent Interpretation Technology of Remote Sensing Images based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In recent years, high-resolution remote sensing images have been increasingly used in the field of geoscience. Therefore, how to interpret high-resolution remote sensing images with high quality is an urgent problem to be solved. This paper takes high-resolution remote sensing images as the research object, uses deep convolutional neural network (CNN) technology, conducts remote sensing image segmentation and feature extraction based on deep convolutional neural network, establishes a high-precision remote sensing image interpretation model, and improves the accuracy and computing speed of intelligent recognition of remote sensing images. This paper uses residual network (ResNet) as a learning sample to compare its performance with the classical algorithm on the same set of samples. Preliminary studies of this project have shown that the accuracy of convolutional neural networks in image analysis can reach 97.1%, and it shows obvious superiority at multiple spatial scales, and can effectively improve the efficiency of image interpretation.

articleTitle: Ensemble Model Based Ship Motion Response Data Analysis and Monitoring Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The Automatic Identification System (AIS) is data suggested the ship monitoring, helps of maritime regulation and practitioners make reasonable are paid to acquire an accurate ship trajectory. However, there are consider various parameter requires to large information to analysis multiple of representations of input data which lead to increased energy, adding complexity to the model training process. In this paper, proposed ensemble model such as linear Support Vector Machine (LSVM), K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), Random Forest (RF) is efficiently analysis the ship motion, better filtering out this noise, providing more stable and reliable prediction. The ship motion is highly non-linear due to wind wave and other environment faction by using ensemble models better capture this non-linear dynamic compared to single models. Initially data occur AIF dataset and data normalization using ensures that feature dominates others due to magnitude and transforming data. The proposed ensemble model technique for ship motion detection is achieving better outcomes such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 2.03, Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE) of 3.45, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 2.45 on raw dataset. The existing technique such Multi-Head Attention Mechanism and Bidirectional Gate Recurrent unit (MHA-BiGRU) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) are evaluated of proposed method.

Author Keywords: bidirectional gate recurrent unit k-nearest neighbour
linear support vector machine and ship motion

articleTitle: Application of Digital Interactive Experience System for Cultural and Tourism based on Augmented Reality with YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Now a day’s tourism industry in Asia is more than ever being modernized by innovative technologies, an undisputable reality that was converting the sector in different ways. To create a memorable experience there were no embracing innovations and feedback mechanism are there for better engagement. In this paper, the proposed Augmented Realities with You Only Look Once (AR-YOLOv3) detects any cultural and tourism objects with marker less AR through an interactive application. Initially, the user and admin login to the web-based system and the details are saved to database for further accessibility. The scale invariant feature transform method is used to extract Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) features from the image. To achieve better performance the SIFT features are divided into threads by using multithreaded approach. These thread frames are given as input to YOLOv3 algorithm for a real-time object detection. The simulation setup for proposed AR-YOLOv3 achieved a better results including accuracy 85.83%, precision 87.29% and recall 88.49%.

articleTitle: PSO-BP Neural Network Model in Stock Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Stock prediction is crucial for financial product pricing, optimal asset allocation, speculative strategy research and risk management, etc., and there are many experts and scholars devoted to stock price prediction analysis. However, due to the volatility and non-linear nature of stock prices, it brings great difficulties to stock prediction, which makes some machine learning methods applied to stock prediction.This study introduces a Particle Swarm Optimization-Back Propagation (PSO-BP) neural network model designed to enhance stock price prediction. The PSO algorithm optimizes the BP neural network by fine-tuning the number of hidden layer nodes, thereby improving prediction accuracy and robustness. Experimental results reveal that the PSO-BP model not only reduces prediction time, averaging between 0.5 to 0.8 seconds, but also demonstrates a more efficient calculation speed compared to the traditional BP algorithm. The PSO-BP model performs better with increased sample data, showing minimal increases in calculation time, thus indicating its robust performance. The findings suggest that the PSO-BP model provides a reliable and efficient method for stock price prediction, with notable improvements in both speed and accuracy compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Compatibility and optimization Strategy of Multiple Network Protocols in the Internet of Things Installation and Debugging Training Bench
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the network protocol compatibility and optimisation of IoT installation and commissioning training platform has become a research focus. In view of the low compatibility of the mainstream protocol stack, which hinders the migration of applications, the research proposes a solution based on unified communication protocols and data formats, which achieves seamless interconnection and efficient data exchange between devices, and significantly improves the compatibility and scalability of the platform. Experiments show that the solution not only significantly enhances protocol compatibility, but also achieves a maximum data transfer rate of 942 kbps and a response speed as low as 516 ms, providing solid support for the efficient operation of the IoT training platform.

articleTitle: Real Time Performance Evaluation of Deep Learning Algorithms in Image Recognition under the Pytorch Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, deep learning has become one of the key technologies in the field of image recognition. PyTorch has become the preferred framework for researchers due to its flexibility, efficiency, and ease of use. This study focuses on the real-time performance of deep learning algorithms in image recognition under the PyTorch framework, and its effectiveness is verified through system experiments. The experiment revealed that the algorithm under this framework exhibits excellent real-time performance in image recognition tasks, with an average frame rate of up to 59.46 FPS and an image processing delay as low as 59.44 milliseconds, fully meeting the demand for efficient processing in a wide range of application scenarios. This discovery demonstrates the powerful potential and practicality of PyTorch in the field of image recognition.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Traffic Control System for Emergency Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Traffic congestion significantly impedes emergency vehicle response times in urban areas. This research introduces an IoT-based traffic control system designed to alleviate this issue by using RFID technology and Arduino microcontrollers. The system detects emergency vehicles via RFID tags and dynamically adjusts traffic signals to provide an uninterrupted path. Implemented with RFID receivers and Arduino controllers, the system ensures real-time management of traffic signals. Results from preliminary tests indicate a substantial reduction in transit times for emergency vehicles. This study demonstrates the potential of IoT-based solutions in improving urban traffic management, enhancing both public safety and emergency response efficiency.

articleTitle: Mitigating Ground Bounce Noise With Super Stacking Structure For Energy Efficient Mpsoc
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Objective: Power gating approach placed a vital role in complex architectures to attain high energy efficiency and reduce the leakage power in most of the embedded applications, Multi-Processor System on Chip (MPSoC), etc. But power gating method generates ground bouncing noise during the mode of operation changes.Methods: To mitigate this limitation, Super Stacking Power Gating (SSPG) technique is proposed which exploits the stacking effect to achieve high energy efficiency with less ground bouncing noise. SSPG based CMOS inverter is designed and simulated in Tanner EDA with 125nm technology.Findings: The evaluation results shows that, the proposed SSPG reduces the leakage power by 25.38%, 32.71%, 40.24%, 30.65%, 15.45%, 26.65%, 31.82%, 12.37% and 24.86%. Novelty: When compared with Sleep transistor, Dual Sleep, Dual Stack, Sleepy Stack, Leakage Control Transistor (LECTOR), Sleepy Keeper, VLSI CMOS Leakage Reduction Technique (VCLEARIT), Gated Leakage Transistor (GALEOR) approach and Sleepy Pass gate approach. It also cut down the ground bouncing noise for two possible inputs of CMOS inverter as ‘0’ by 62.16%, 59.42%, 55.55%, 58.20%, 54.83%, 52.54%, 41.66%, 36.36%, 20% and input as ‘1’ by 58.53%, 53.42%, 50.72%, 53.42%, 50.72%, 47.69%, 40.35%, 32%, 12.82% over other ground bouncing noise mitigation approaches.

articleTitle: Enhanced Optical Design: Optimizing MTF Through Overlapping Aperture MLA Configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This study introduces a novel microlens array (MLA) design incorporating overlapping apertures to enhance flexibility in MLA structure requirements, utilizing chief ray tracing and paraxial imaging optics in projection imaging analysis. The design achieves consistent illumination across the field of vision (FOV) and maintains a compact form factor. Comparative analysis between a sample 3x3 MLA projector and the proposed 3x3 MLA projector, both with equal aperture sizes, demonstrates the effectiveness of the overlapping apertures. Simulations show significant improvements in FOV and modulation transfer function (MTF), as validated by diffraction MTF analysis. The two-layer overlapping structure has modulation depths larger than 0.6, 0.5, and 0.3 for 2o, 5o, and 7o Semi-FOVs. This research contributes to the development of more sophisticated and efficient small MLA projection optical systems, offering advancements in uniform lighting, increased FOV, and improved MTF.

articleTitle: Optimization of Algorithm for Network Traffic Anomaly Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of network technology, network security issues have become particularly prominent, especially in the context of big data and the Internet plus era, traditional network anomaly detection methods have been difficult to meet the needs of modern network security. This article studies a convolutional neural network model suitable for traffic data features, which can effectively extract spatiotemporal features from traffic data; an innovative data preprocessing technique is introduced to enhance the model’s generalization ability through data augmentation and feature standardization. The research results indicate that compared with traditional rule-based and machine learning-based detection methods, the method proposed in this study has significantly improved detection speed and accuracy. In the absence of any noise, the accuracy of the model reached 99.0%, demonstrating its excellent performance on pure datasets. This study not only optimized the application of CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) in network traffic anomaly detection, but also provided theoretical basis and experimental support for the development of future network security technology.

articleTitle: Symmetric Adaptive Population Division Based Salp Swarm Algorithm for Resource Optimization in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In the present advanced world, Cloud Computing (CC) is essential across various applications because of its quick development and wide utilization of Internet technologies. However, it faces some issues in the identification of best resources and task allocation for classifying relevant tasks based on the load. The Symmetric Adaptive Population Division based Salp Swarm Algorithm (SAPD-SSA) is proposed for optimal resource allocation in the CC environment. The SAPD-SSA enhances the convergence speed by efficiently dividing populations into subgroups. This approach enhances the balance among exploration and exploitation which leads to better resource utilization in CC. Moreover, it effectively handles complex and dynamic cloud environments which ensures optimal resource allocation with less computational cost. The multi-objective functions of makespan, resource utilization and computation cost are considered in this research for estimating the effectiveness of proposed SAPD-SSA. The makespan, resource utilization and computation cost are taken as evaluation metrics for assessing SAPD-SSA performance. The SAPD-SSA attains a makespan of 250, resource utilization of 98.28% and computation cost of 950$ for the task of 200, which is superior to the Hybrid Whale optimization algorithm-with Mutation based Bees algorithm (HWOA-mBA).

articleTitle: Network Traffic Anomaly Detection Using t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding and Variational Autoencoder Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The rapid expansion of technology and connected devices has intensified the focus on cyberattacks that compromise devices and generate massive traffic volumes disrupting Internet services. This paper presents a t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding and Variational Autoencoder (t-SNE-VAE) for efficient network traffic anomaly detection. The input data was preprocessed by using min-max normalization where it provided standard scaling to avoid imbalance in data. The t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding (t-SNE) is employed for feature extraction and dimensionality reduction. The Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with high reconstruction ability is employed to detect anomaly in network traffic. Using NSL-KDD dataset, the proposed method reduces data dimensionality and captures complex patterns with significant improvement in detection accuracy. The proposed approach enhances the detection of network anomalies, improves the interpretability and robustness of the model. The proposed t-SNE-VAE model achieved high accuracy of 99.87%, precision of 99.50%, and recall of 99.34%, surpassing several state-of-the-art methods such as Semi-supervised Gated Recurrent Unit (SEMI-GRU), Stacked-Deep Polynomial Network with Spider Monkey Optimization (SDPN-SMO).

articleTitle: Selective Kernel Spatial Feature Extraction based Deep Learning Approach for Identification and Classification of Archaeological Sites
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Deep Learning (DL) based identification and classification of archaeological sites are being used progressively from satellite images obtained from Geographic Information System (GIS). Even though, there were promising results from the existing researches, there is still need to enhance the classification with distinct features of the satellite images. The methods found challenging to accurately or partially identify an archaeological feature especially in a complex landscape due to lack of distinction between archaeological and non-archaeological features. For this, the geo-referenced satellite images are considered in this research, which are pre-processed using min-max normalization for efficient data analysis and to remove unwanted data. The Selective kernel spatial Feature Extraction (SFE) module is used to improve the feature extraction process where the spatial features are extracted. The extracted features are then classified using Fully Convoluted Deep Neural Network (FCDNN) for effective identification and classification of archaeological sites. The results showed that the proposed SFE-FCDNN achieved better classification accuracy with 98.83%, precision of 97.41%, and an error rate of 1.71 when compared to the existing methods such as Neural Network (NN), and Backpropagation Neural Network (BNN).

articleTitle: Research on Factors Affecting Financial Stock Price Fluctuations based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This paper studies the factors affecting the volatility of financial stock prices, inputs stock related information into the convolutional neural network on the basis of understanding the convolutional neural network, completes the model training, and obtains the neuronal threshold and the gradient of connection weight of the whole convolutional network through calculation. A convolutional neural network model improved by genetic algorithm is constructed, and the factors affecting stock price changes are predicted by this model. It is found that the significance of five factors, such as trading volume and exchange rate, is the highest, and all pass the bilateral significance level test of 0.1. Five factors, such as the growth rate of industrial added value and retail sales of social consumer goods, were identified as "strong indicators". When the stock price fluctuation is greater than 0.05, the prediction accuracy of this model reaches 100%. Therefore, the method in this paper can accurately determine the main factors affecting stock price volatility.

articleTitle: A Robust MAES Encryption And Decryption Algorithm using Ankaru Model Through Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The world as a whole now depends on the data that people have stored online and how these developments are tracked in the future. To satisfy the requirements of safeguarding the information of an individual, a company, or a rapidly growing sector, there is only one standard. The first phase, encryption, and the second, decryption, are absolutely necessary to complete. Data is encrypted for protection, then it is decrypted for retrieval. The Advanced Encryption Standard provides the highest level of security for data protection, ensuring that its processing remains hidden. Data on edge devices is encrypted using the AES method by Fog. Since AES has never experienced a data breach, safety and security are the most fundamental truths that may be discovered through its use. Data from Edge devices is encrypted and then modified using fog computing to secure it using the AES technique. The data is then recovered by decryption. The secret key is primarily concerned with data entering and returning to the source, which transforms the proper propagation outcome.

articleTitle: Recent advancements in Image Steganography using Generative Adversarial Networks methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks are employed by GAN-based models in image steganography to efficiently conceal information from images while preserving their visual integrity. These models are made up of two primary parts: the discriminator which determines if an image is a real image or a stego-image, and the generator which embeds the hidden data into images. The generator learns how to embed data in a way that minimizes obvious distortions through adversarial training, where the discriminator and generator fight to make the hidden data less noticeable to detection algorithms and human observers. High data capacity and versatility are strengths of GAN-based steganography models, which enable efficient data concealment across a variety of image formats and steganographic techniques. They dynamically adjust the embedding procedure to strike a compromise between image quality and data capacity. They do, however, come with certain drawbacks such as the need for sophisticated model training, high processing overhead and hyperparameter sensitivity. Notwithstanding these drawbacks, GAN-based techniques mark a substantial breakthrough in the development of delicate and reliable image steganography techniques.

articleTitle: Enhanced Framework for Authentic and Anonymous Data Sharing Over Cloud Storage Service
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: This study introduces the concept of anonymous data exchange in banking applications using cloud computing. By intertwining innovative methodologies, the proposed framework bolsters security while introducing novel dimensions to the authentication landscape. Key to the system’s architecture is the integration of RSA and SHA algorithms within the framework. In the contemporary digital landscape, the banking sector confronts escalating challenges in establishing robust authentication and security measures to safeguard sensitive customer data and transactions. Color-coded passwords offer a pioneering approach, enhancing traditional authentication methods with added security. Furthermore, the system advocates for integrate multi-factor authentication techniques, thereby reinforcing the authentication process. This integration ensures the confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of sensitive data transmitted between clients. The performance of this integrated algorithm is compared with other encryption algorithms, and it is observed that the proposed mechanism encryption time is 10% faster. The encrypted message was tested on an online simulator to attempt deciphering and could not be decrypted, confirming its security.

articleTitle: Chinese Ethnic Music Classification by Hybrid 1D-Convolutional Neural Networks and Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In recent times, youngsters used multimedia more regularly for communication purpose with other in internet platform. Music is emotional support for abandoned in pandemic music which is dominant tool for emotional regulation of self-receiving free from aloneness this, paper focuses on classification of Chinese music. The proposed 1-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Units (1D-CNN-Bi-GRU) is worked on DEAP dataset and sends this data input to 1D-CNN layer which consists of two conv 1D layer with max pooling functions and batch normalization is used for extracting of features and improve generalization ability. After this input sends to 1D-CNN-Bi-GRU, which consists of two hidden layers and works on reset and update gate then this sent to flatten layers, dense layer by using softmax layers and achieved more precision and recall of 95.67% and 94.65 % when compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: Link Prediction in Knowledge Graphs for Graph Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In the cloud computing environment, the application of data encryption technology is of great significance to the improvement of network information security. This paper discusses the key challenges and solutions of data encryption technology in cloud computing, focusing on the application of symmetric and asymmetric encryption technologies and their effects. Comparative experimental analyses show that symmetric encryption has a processing speed of about 10,000 encryption operations per second and low resource consumption, while asymmetric encryption has a processing speed of about 500 encryption operations per second but excels in security and key management. The experimental results show that the combined use of symmetric and asymmetric encryption can achieve more efficient and secure data protection in cloud computing environments. Ultimately, this paper suggests future research directions to further enhance data security in cloud computing environments.

articleTitle: Intelligent Building Optimization Design Based on Artificial Neural Network with Tasmanian Devil Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: According to recent economic conditions, construction industry is experiencing a major shift and raising to intelligent building model. Thus, the incorporation of analyzing construction industry requirements as well as introduced a development mode for construction model. However, the building model constructed based on the needs consumes more energy and less effective. To overcome this limitation, an Artificial Neural Network with Tasmanian Devil Optimization (ANN-TDO) algorithm is proposed to predict and evaluate the intelligent building optimization design. The combination of ANN and TDO provide accurate energy demand predictions, and optimize the system based on those predictions, leading to more effective and adaptive energy-saving solutions. Initially, the data are considered the properties of building like energy consumption, temperature, weather condition and so on. Then, a building model is designed using wireless sensor network and those parameters fed to proposed business model. The experimental results of proposed method achieved accuracy of 95.8% which is higher than the existing methods such as Non-Sorted Adaptive Genetic Algorithm-III (NSGA-III).

articleTitle: Support Vector Machine with Tunicate Swarm Optimization Algorithm for Emotion Recognition in Human-Robot Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The rapid development of computer programs for the automatic classification of human emotions in recent years has drawn the attention of researchers. However, existing techniques have not addressed context-information included in facial expressions properly. In this research, a Tunicate Swarm Optimization Algorithm with Support Vector Machine (TSOA-SVM) to tackle the issue and enhance performance in emotion recognition. Then, ORL dataset was is used to the recommended approach to collect the data, then it was image-scaled and enhanced as part of the preparation process. Moreover, characteristics from previously processed images are extracted using Wavelet Transform and Entropy characteristics. After that, the classification stage is used to these derived traits to ascertain whether or not they include emotions. The proposed technique achieved high accuracy of 99.42%, specificity of 99.54%, and sensitivity of 99.35% in distinguishing the emotions when compared to other existing methods such as Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-Nearest Neighbour.

Author Keywords: human robot interaction. support vector machine

articleTitle: Decentralized Online Marketplace Using Blockchain Technology for Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The integration of blockchain technology into e-commerce holds transformative potential by leveraging decentralization, transparency, and security to redefine online transactions. This research explores a decentralized online marketplace that integrates blockchain with e- commerce functionalities, utilizing smart contracts and wallet integration to decentralize product listing, inventory management, and identity verification. The envisioned marketplace aims to meet the sustainable development through promoting responsible consumption, ethical sourcing, and environmentally friendly practices. By enhancing transactional security and transparency, blockchain facilitates a more efficient, equitable, and sustainable ecosystem for online commerce. Using this method one can achieve transparency and enhanced security. This study contributes to conceptualizing and implementing a framework where blockchain technology supports not only transactional efficiency but also ethical and sustainable business practices in e- commerce. Compared to traditional blockchain e- commerce there is a significant increase in the parametric observations such as security, transparency and efficiency

articleTitle: Transudative Long Short Term Memory based Network Traffic Prediction in Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: In Wireless Mesh Network (WMN), traffic-conscious consistent entrance selection is significant for improving the Quality of Service (QoS) and enhancing the effectiveness of the network model. However, the complex spatial-temporal patterns of the user demand concentrate on the prediction of the mobile traffic, which accounts for a majority of the present network, thereby being challenging. Hence, this research proposes the Transudative Long Short-Term Memory (TLSTM) approach for the prediction of the Network traffics in WMN. The TLSTM model's ability to capture long-term dependencies helps in understanding and predicting complex traffic patterns and trends. Initially, the data is collected from High-Speed Diesel (HSD) pump, which is predicted through detecting the model’s results. The effectiveness of the HSD pumps is detected through a vibration parameter as an outcome parameter. The experimental results show that the proposed TLSTM approach attains a better Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.008 and 0.009 respectively as the monthly and yearly prediction as compared to the existing method, hybrid Convolutional Neural Network with LSTM (Conv-LSTM) approach.

Author Keywords: transudative long short-term memory and wireless mesh network

articleTitle: Modelling and Evaluation of Li-ion Battery Performance Based on the Electric Vehicle Tiled Tests using Kalman Filter-GBDT Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: A new market has opened up because to innovations in lithium-ion battery (LIB) technology, and that market includes the vehicle sector. Many LIBs are now praising the possibility of a transportation industry that produces less greenhouse gas emissions as a means to fight against climate change. In order to be put on the market, expensive electric vehicles that rely on batteries must fulfill stringent requirements for LIBs regarding safety, lifetime, energy density, and fast-charging. This approach outlines three steps: preprocessing the model text, feature extraction, and training. Battery big data analysis's distribution features are utilized during the pre-processing phase. By combining the cyclic and calendar losses of LIBs, the smart feature selection (SFS) method can accurately forecast these losses during feature selection. The model was trained using a Kalman Filter-GBDT. The average accuracy of the suggested method is 94.53%, which is superior than both the Kalman Filter and GBDT.

articleTitle: A MobileUnet++-based Abnormality Segmentation and Multi-scale Network Approach for Brain Tumor Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: Tumors are a pervasive concern in modern life, driven by cellular irregularities that disrupt the orderly division necessary for healthy cell growth. However, brain tumors present unique challenges compared to tumors in other regions due to the intricacies of brain structure and function. A brain tumor occurs when cells in the cerebral cortex undergo uncontrolled proliferation. Diagnosing brain tumors, especially in their early stages is a formidable task that often relies on manual examination of medical images by radiologists or healthcare professionals. Despite various approaches to brain tumor classification, precision remains paramount while ensuring practical utility in segmentation and classification tasks. Traditional methods are often manual, time-consuming and lacking in automated classification capabilities, hampering efficient decision-making. The advent of deep learning technology has revolutionized medical image processing, particularly in the realm of brain tumor analysis. Deep learning algorithms, powered by vast datasets and computational prowess, offer remarkable capabilities in automating segmentation and classification tasks, thereby enhancing accuracy and efficiency in diagnosing brain tumors. Consequently, this study introduces a method for smart brain tumor segmentation and classification leveraging deep learning techniques. The process begins with acquiring essential images through established benchmarking techniques. These images are then processed in the abnormality segmentation phase, utilizing Mobile-Unet++ (MUnet++) for segmentation. Following segmentation, the images undergo a classification phase, where brain tumors are classified using Multi-scale Mobilenet (MMNet). To validate effectiveness of proposed technique, an efficacy study is conducted, comparing it against traditional methodologies for segmentation and classification of brain.

articleTitle: Integrating Digital Twins with AI for Real-Time Intrusion Detection in Smart Infrastructure Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: The integration of Digital Twins with Artificial Intelligence (AI) represents a revolutionary approach to enhancing real-time intrusion detection in smart infrastructure networks. Digital Twins, as virtual replicas of physical assets, enable continuous monitoring and predictive analysis, while AI provides advanced analytical capabilities for identifying and mitigating potential security threats. This paper presents a comprehensive framework that leverages Digital Twins in conjunction with AI algorithms to detect and respond to intrusions in smart infrastructure networks. By simulating network behavior and employing machine learning models to analyze data patterns, the proposed system ensures robust security measures. One of the proposed techniques involves the use of a hybrid anomaly detection algorithm combining Autoencoders and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). The Autoencoder is utilized to learn a compact representation of the normal network behavior by reducing dimensionality and reconstructing inputs, while the RNN captures temporal dependencies and sequences within the network data. This hybrid model enhances the detection of both known and unknown intrusion patterns by focusing on deviations from the learned normal behavior. The integration of these AI components with Digital Twins enables a more nuanced and accurate understanding of network anomalies, thereby improving the system's ability to detect and respond to intrusions promptly. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of this approach in real-time threat detection, showcasing significant improvements in response times and accuracy. This integration not only enhances the resilience of smart infrastructure but also paves the way for future advancements in secure and intelligent network management.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-Driven Intrusion Detection for IoT and Cyber-Physical System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Algorithms for Computational Intelligence Systems (IACIS)
abstract: From smart homes to industrial automation, the efficiency and connectivity of many applications have been greatly improved by the fast expansion of the Internet of Things (IoT) and Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS). Sophisticated cyberattacks are becoming more common in this networked ecosystem, thus strong security measures are needed. In order to protect CPS and IoT settings, this study presents a new intrusion detection method that makes use of Digital Twin technology. To build an adaptable and dynamic Intrusion Detection System (IDS), our suggested architecture combines Digital Twins with state-of-the-art machine learning methods. In order to accurately detect and categorize any threats, the IDS constantly learns from data in both the past and the present.
